a: Tere iske vechad shetara – peseda delove.

Veamar rava: hay man dekabbel iska min chavreh ufesed, terach umalleyeh vela odeh, la matze amar leh: deri mehayech peseda bahaday. mishshum daamar leh: lehachi teracht (lemallayoteh) [umalleteh] – ki hechi dela likro lach "mafsed iske".

Veamar rava: hane be tere deavdi iska bahade hadade urevavch, vaamar leh chad lechavreh: ta liflog, i amar leh iddach: narvavch tefe – dina hu dimakkev. vei amar leh: hav li palga deravvcha – amar leh: ravvcha – lekarna mishtabed.

Vei amar leh: hav li palga ravvcha ufalga karna – amar leh: iska lahadade meshuebad. vei amar leh: niflog ravvcha veniflog karna, vei mate lach peseda darena bahadach – amar leh: la mazzala deve tere adif.

Mishna hamekabbel sade mechavero velo ratza lenakkesh, veamar lo: ma ichpat lecha? hoil vaani noten lecha et chachirach – en shomin lo. mippene sheyyachol lomar lo: lemachar atta yotze mimmenna umaalet lefanay asavim.

Gemara i amar leh: levatar hachi karevna la – amar leh: chitte mealleyayta baena. vei amar leh: zavenna lach chitte mishshuka – amar leh: chitte dearay baena. vei amar leh menakkeshna lach shiur menataych – amar leh: ka mansevat shem ra learay.
Vehatnan: mippene shemmaalet lefanay asavim! ella mishshum deamar leh: bizra dinfal – nefal.
Mishna hamekabbel sade mechavero velo asta, im yesh bah kede lehaamid keri – chayyayv littappel bah. amar rabbi yehuda: may kitzva bichri? ella im yesh bah kede nefila.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: hamekabbel sade mechavero velo asta, im yesh bah kede lehaamid keri – chayyayv littappel bah. shekkach kotev lo: ana evkoym veenur veezra veechtzod vaaammar veedush veedre veokem karya kodamach, vetete ant vetittol palga, vaana beamli uvenafkut yeday palga.
Vechamma kede lehaamid bah keri? amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: kede shettaamod bo harachat. ibbaya lehu: rachat hayyotze mehay gisa lehay gisa, may?

Ta shema: amar rabbi avahu, ledidi mipparsha li minneh derabbi yose berabbi chanina: kol sheen kones shello roe pene hachamma. ittemar: levi amar shalosh sein, deve rabbi yannay amri satayim. amar resh lakish: satayim sheamru chutz min hahotzaa.
Tenan hatam: paritze zetim vaanavim, bet shammay metammein, uvet hillel metaharin.

May paritze zetim? amar rav huna: rishe zetim. amar rav yosef: umay keraa – "[uvene] paritze ammecha yinnasseu lehaamid chazon venichshalu". rav nachman bar yitzchak amar: mehacha – "veholid ben paritz shofech dam".
Vechamma paritze zetim? rabbi elazar amar: arbaat kabbin lakkora. deve rabbi yannay amri: satayim lakkora.
Vela peligi: ha beatra dimayyeyli kora beolala, ha beatra dimayyeyli telata korin beolala.
Tanu rabbanan:
b: Alu beilan shekkocho ra, uvesocha shekkochah ra – tame.
Hechi dame ilan shekkocho ra? amri deve rabbi yannay: kol sheen beikkaro lachok rova. hechi dame socha shekkochah ra? amar resh lakish: kol shennechbet bechezyonah.
Tenan hatam: hamehallech bevet happeras, al gabbe avanim sheyyachol lehasit, al haadam veal habbehema shekkochan ra – tame.
Hechi dame adam shekkocho ra? amar resh lakish: kol sherochvo vearchubbotav nokshot. hechi dame behema shekkochah ra? amri deve rabbi yannay: kol sherochvah [u]metila gelalim.
Amri deve rabbi yannay: litfilla velitfillin arbaa kabbin.
Litfilla may hi? detanya: hannose massooy al ketefo vehiggia zeman tefilla, pachot mearbaa kabbin – mafshilayn laachorav umitpallel. arbaa kabbin – manniach al gabbe karka umitpallel.
Litfillin may – hi detanya: haya nose massooy al rosho utefillin berosho, im hayu tefillin rotztzot – asur, veim lav – muttar. beezo massooy amru – bemassooy shel arbaat kabbin.

Tane rabbi chiyyay: hammotzi zevel al rosho utefillin berosho – hare ze lo yesallekem litzdadin, velo yiksherem bemotnav, mippene shehu noheg bahen minhag bizzayon. aval koshram al zeroo bimkom tefillin.
Mishshum rabbi shela amru: afillu mitpachat shellahen asur lehanniach al harosh sheyyesh bo tefillin. vechamma? amar abbaye: afillu riva deriva defumebdita.

Amar rabbi yehuda: may kitzva bichri? ella: im yesh bo kede nefila. vechamma kede nefila? rabbi amme amar rabbi yochanan: arbao sein lechor. rabbi amme dileh amar: shemonat sein lechor. amar leh hahu sava lerav chama bereh derabba bar avu: asbera lach, bishne derabbi yochanan hava shammina ara, bishne derabbi amme hava kechisha ara.
Tenan hatam: haruach sheppizzera et haomarin, omdim otah kamma leket reuya laasot venoten laaniyyim. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: noten laaniyyim kede nefila.
Vechamma kede nefila? ki ata rav dimi, amar rabbi elazar veittema rabbi yochanan: arbaat kabbin lechor. bae rabbi yirmeya: lechor zera, o lechor tevua? lemappolet yad, o lemappolet shevorim?
Ta shema, dechi ata ravin, amar rabbi avu amar rabbi elazar, veamri lah amar rabbi yochanan: arbaat kabbin lechor zera. vaadayin tibbee lach: lemappolet yad o lemappolet shevorim? teku.

Mishna hamekabbel sade mechavero vaachalah chagav, o nishdefa. im makkat medina hi – menakke lo min chachoro. im enah makkat medina – en menakke lo min chachoro. rabbi yehuda omer: im kibbelah hemennu bemaot, ben kach uven kach eno menakke lo mechachoro.
Gemara hechi dame makkat medina? amar rav yehuda: kegon deishteduf rubba devaga. ulla amar: kegon shennishtaddefu arba sadot mearba ruchoteha.
Amar ulla, bau bemareva: nishdaf telem echad al pene kullah, may? nishtayyer telem echad al pene kullah, mahu? ippesiko beyara, may? aspasta,

a: May? zera acher, may? chitte legabbe (seorim) [seare] kezera acher dame, o la? kol haolam kullo beshiddafon, veshello beyerakon, i name: kol haolam kullo beyerakon, veshello beshiddafon, may? teku.

Amar leh: zira chitte, vaazal hu vezara seare, veishteduf rubba devaga, veishteduf name hanach seare dileh, may? mi amrinan deamar leh: illu zerata chitte hava name mishtadfa, o dilma matze amar leh: illu zerata chitte hava mikkayyaym bi "vetigzar omer veyakom lach"?
Mistabbera deamar leh: i zerata chitte hava mikkayyaym bi "vetigzar omer veyakom lach veal derachecha naga or".

Nishtadfu kol sedotav shel machkir, veishteduf name ha bahadayyhu, vela ishteduf rubba devaga, may? mi amrinan kevan dela ishteduf rubba devaga – la menakke leh, o dilma kevan deishteduf kullehu arateh, matze amar leh: hay mishshum lattach didach hu, deha (mishtadfu) [nishtadfu] kol sedotecha.
Mistabbera deamar leh: i mishshum lattay didi – hava mishtayyayr li pureta, kedichtiv: "ki nisharnu meat meharebe".

Nishtadfu kol sedotav shel chocher veishteduf rubba devaga, veishteduf name ha bahadayyhu, may? mi amrinan kevan deishteduf rubba devaga menakke leh, o dilma kevan deishteduf kullehu arateh, matze amar leh: mishshum lattach didach hu, deha (mishtadfu) [nishtadfu] kol sedotecha. mistabbera deamar leh: mishshum lattach hu.

Ammay? hacha name nema leh: i mishshum lattay didi hu – hava mish[ta]yayr li pureta, dahava mikkayyaym bi "ki nisharnu meat meharebe". mishshum daamar leh: i hava chazet leishtayyore lach midde – hava mishtayyayr lach middenafshach.
Metivi: hayta shenat shiddafon veyerakon, o sheviit, o shehayu shanim kishne eliyyahu – eno ole lo min hamminyan.

Katane: shiddafon veyerakon dumeya deshanim kishne eliyyahu, ma shene eliyyahu – dela havay tevua kelal, af hacha name – dela havay tevua kelal. aval deikka tevua – salka leh, vela kaamrinan makkat medina hi!
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: shane hatam, deamar kera: "bemispar shene tevuot yimkor lach", shanim sheyyesh bahen tevua baolam.
Amar leh rav ashe lerav kahana: ella meatta sheviit taale lo min hamminyan, deha ikka tevua bechutza laaretz! amar leh: sheviit afkata demalka hi.
Amar leh mar zutera bereh derav mari leravina: ella meatta, sheviit lo taale lo min haggerua! allema tenan: noten sela ufunedyon leshana! amar leh: shane hatam dechazya lemishtacho ba pere.
Amar shemuel: lo shanu, ella shezzeraah vetzimmecha vaachalah chagav. aval lo zeraah kelal – la, deamar leh: illu zerata hava mikkayyaym bi "lo yevoshu beet raa uvime reavon yisbau".

Metiv rav sheshet: roe shehaya roe vehinniach edro uva lair, uva zeev vetaraf, uva ari vedaras – en omrim: illu haya sham haya matztzil, ella omdin oto im yachol lehatztzil – chayyayv, veim lav – patur. veammay? nema leh: i havet hatam hava mikkayyaym bi "gam et haari gam haddov hikka avdecha"!

Mishshum daamar leh: i havet chazet leitrechoshe lach nissa, hava (itrechish) [mitrechish] lach nissa kerabbi chanina ben dosa demetyayn izze dubbe bekarnayyhu. venema leh: nehi dilnissa rabba la hava chazena – lenissa zuta
b: Chazena? kashya.
Tane chada: paam rishona usheniyya zorah, ushelishit eno zorah. vetanya iddach: shelishit zorah, reviit eno zorah. la kashya: ha kerabbi, ha kerabban shimon ben gamliel.
Ha kerabbi, deamar: bitre zimne havya[1] chazaka. ha kerabban shimon ben gamliel, deamar: bitlat zimne havya[1] chazaka.

Amar resh lakish: lo shanu ella shezzeraah vetzimmecha vaachalah chagav. aval zeraah velo tzimmecha – matze amar leh baal hakkarka: kol yeme zera zerao la veezil. vead emat? amar rav pappa: ad deatu arise middavra vekayyma kima areshayyhu.
Metivi: rabban shimon ben gamliel mishshum rabbi meir omer, vechen haya rabbi shimon ben menasya omer kidvarav: chatzi tishre, merachshevan, vachatzi chislev – zera.

Chatzi chislev, tevet, vachatzi shevat – choref. chatzi shevat, adar, vachatzi nisan – kor. chatzi nisan, iyyayr, vachatzi sivan – katzir. chatzi sivan, tammuz, vachatzi av – kayitz. chatzi av, elul, vachatzi tishre – chom.
Rabbi yehuda mone mittishri, rabbi shimon mone mimmerachshevan.
Man mekel bechullehu – rabbi shimon, vechulle hay la kaamar! la kashya: ha dekabbela minneh becharfe, ha dekabbele minneh beafle.

Rabbi yehuda omer: im kibbela mimmennu bemaot. hahu gavra dekabbel ara lemizrao bahv tume aggudda dinhar malka sava bezuze. istechar nehar malka sava. ata lekammeh derava, amar leh: nehar malka sava la avid demistechar, makkat medina hi, zil nakke leh.
Amaru leh rabbanan lerava: ha anan tenan, rabbi yehuda omer: im kibbela hemennu bemaot – ben kach uven kach eno menakka lo min chachoro! amar lehu: let dechash la lidrabbi yehuda.
Mishna hamekabbel sade mechavero baasara kor chittim leshana velakta – noten lo mittochah. hayu chitteha yafot, lo yomar lo: hareni lokeach min hashshuk, ella noten lo mittochah.

Gemara hahu gavra dekabbel ara leaspasta bechore disare, avada aspasta, vecharsha vezara seare, uleko hane seare. shalcha rav chaviva missura difrat lekammeh deravina, ki hay gavna may: ki "lakta noten lo mittochah" dame, o la?
Amar leh: mi dame? hatam la avada ara shelichuta demara, hacha avada ara shelichuta demara.

Hahu gavra dekabbel pardes mechavreh baasar danne chamra, tekef hahu chamra. sevar rav kahana lememar: hayeynu matnitin – lakta noten lo mittochah. amar leh rav ashe: mi dame? hatam la avada ara shelichuta, hacha avada ara shelichuta.
Umode rav ashe beinneve dichdum uvesade shellakta baomareha.

Mishna hamekabbel sade mechavero lezorah seorim – lo yizraenna chittim. chittim – yizraenna seorim, rabban shimon ben gamliel oser. tevua – lo yizraenna kitnit. kitnit – yizraenna tevua, verabban shimon ben gamliel oser.
Gemara amar rav chisda: may tama derabban shimon ben gamliel, dichtiv: "sheerit yisrael lo yaasu avla velo yedabberu chazav velo yimmatze befihem leshon tarmit".

Metivi: migbat purim lefurim, veen medakdekin baddavar. veen heani rashshay likkach mehen retzua lesandalo, ella im ken hitna bemaamad anshe hair, divre rabbi yaakov sheamar mishshum rabbi meir. rabban shimon ben gamliel

a: Mekel,
Amar abbaye, tama derabban shimon kidmar. deamar mar: hay man denicha leh detitbayyar areh – lizrea shatta chitte veshatta seare, shatta sheti veshatta erev.
Vela amaran ella dela karev vetane, aval karev vetane – let lan ba.
Tevua lo yizraenna kitnit [vechulei]. matne leh rav yehuda leravin: tevua – yizraenna kitnit. amar leh: veha anan tenan: tevua – lo yizraenna kitnit! amar leh: la kashya, ha lan veha lehu.
Amar leh rav yehuda leravin bar rav nachman: ravin achi, hane tachle deve chittana en bahen mishshum gazel. omdot al gevulin – yesh bahen mishshum gazel.
Veim hukeshu lezera – afillu deve chittana name yesh bahem mishshum gazel. may tama? may deafsed – afsed.
Amar leh rav yehuda leravin bar rav nachman: ravin achi, hane dili – dilach, vedilach – dili. nehug bene mitzra: ilan hannote lechan – lechan, vehannote lechan – lechan.
Deittemar: ilan haomed al hammetzer, amar rav: hannote lechan – lechan. vehannote lechan – lechan, ushemuel amar: cholkin.
Metivi: ilan haomed al hammetzer – yachloku. teyuveta derav! targema shemuel allibba derav, bimmalle kol hammetzer kullo.
I hachi, may lememra? la tzericha ditle tuneh lechad gisa. veakkatti may lememra? mahu detema: deamar leh pelog hachi, ka mashma lan deamar leh: may chazet defalgat hachi – pelog hachi.

Amar leh rav yehuda leravin bar rav nachman: ravin achi, la tizboyn ara dismicha lemata, deamar rabbi avahu amar rav huna amar rav: asur lo leadam sheyyaamod al sede chavero beshaa sheomedet bekamoteha.
Ini? veha ashkechinhu rabbi abba letalmideh derav, amar lehu: may amar rav behane kerae "baruch atta bair uvaruch atta bassade", "baruch atta bevoecha uvaruch atta betzetecha"?

Vaamaru leh, hachi amar rav: "baruch atta bair" – sheyyehe betcha samuch levet hakkeneset. "baruch atta bassade" – sheyyehu nechasecha kerovim lair. "baruch atta bevoecha" – shello timtza ishtecha sefek nidda bishat biatcha min hadderech. "baruch atta betzetecha" – sheyyehu tzeetzae meecha kemotcha.
Vaamar lehu: rabbi yochanan la amar hachi, ella: "baruch atta bair" – sheyyehe bet hakkisse samuch leshulechancha, aval bet hakkeneset la. verabbi yochanan letameh, deamar: sechar pesiot yesh.

"Baruch atta bassade" – sheyyehu nechasecha meshullashin: shelish bitvua, shelish bezetim, ushelish bigfanim. "baruch atta bevoecha uvaruch atta betzetecha" – shettehe yetziatcha min haolam keviatcha leolam. ma biatcha leolam belo chet, af yetziatcha min haolam belo chet.
b: La kashya: ha dimhaddar leh shura veritka, ha dela mehaddar leh shura veritka.
"Vehesir Adonai mimmecha kol choli", amar rav: zo [ha]ayin. rav letameh. derav salek leve kivre, avad may daavad, amar: tishin vetisha beayin raa, veechad bederech eretz.
Ushemuel amar: ze haruach. shemuel letameh, deamar shemuel: hakkol baruach. velishmuel: ha ikka haruge malchut! hanach name, i lav zika, avdi lehu samma vechaye.
Rabbi chanina amar: zo tzinna, deamar rabbi chanina: hakkol bide shamayim, chutz mitztzinnim pachim. shenneemar: "tzinnim pachim bederech ikkesh shomer nafsho yirchak mehem".
Rabbi yose bar chanina amar: zo tzoa. deamar mar: tzoat hachotem, vetzoat haozen – rubban kashe, umiutan yafe.

Rabbi elazar amar: zo mara. tanya name hachi: "machala" – zo mara, velamma nikra shemah "machala" – shehi machala kol gufo shel adam. davar acher: "machala", sheshshemonim ushelosha cholaim teluyin bammara. vechullan, pat shacharit bemelach vekiton shel mayim mevattaltan.

Tanu rabbanan: shelosha asar devarim neemru befat shacharit: matztzelet min hachamma, umin hatztzinna, umin hazzikin, umin hammazzikin, umachkimat peti, vezoche baddin, lilmod tora ulelammed, udevarav nishmain, vetalmudo mitkayyem beyado,
Veen besaro maale hevel, venizkak leishto, veeno mitavve leishsha acheret, vehoreget kinna shebbivne meayim. veyesh omrim: af motzia[5] et hakkina umachnese[400] et haahava.

Amar leh rabba lerava bar mari: mena ha milleta deamri inashe: shittin rahoyte rehut vela meto legavra demitztzafra kerach. vaamaru rabbanan: hashekem veechol, bekayitz mippene hachamma uvachoref mippene hatztzinna.
Amar leh, dichtiv: "lo yiravu velo yitzmau velo yakkem sharav vashamesh", lo yakkem sharav vashamesh – kevan dela yiravu velo yitzmau.

Amar leh: at amrat li mehatam, vaana amena lach mehacha: "vaavadtem et Adonai elohechem uverach et lachmecha veet memecha". "vaavadtem et Adonai elohechem" – zo keriat shema utefilla. "uverach et lachmecha veet memecha" – zo pat bammelach vekiton shel mayim, mikkan veelach: "vahasiroti machala mikkirbecha".

Amar leh rav yehuda lerav adda mashochaa: la tezalzel bemishchata, dechol pureta ufureta chazi lechurekma rishka. amar leh rav yehuda lerav adda mashochaa: arba ammot deannigra – zalzel behu. deannahara la timshechinhu kelal.
Rav yehuda letameh, deamar rav yehuda: arba ammot deannigra – livne nigra. deannahara – dechulle alma.

Machriz rabbi amme: mele katfe naggade bitre evre nahara – kutzu. rav natan bar hoshaya katz shittesar ammeta. ato aleh bene mashronya, dafnu. hu savar kirshut harabbim, vela hi: hatam baenan kulle hay, hacha mishshum amtoche (ashlehen) [ashlayhu] hu, kimle katfe naggade saggi.

Rabba bar rav huna hava leh hahu ibba aggudda denahara, amaru leh: nikkotz mar! amar lehu: kutzu illae vetattae, vahadar nikkotz ana. hechi aved hachi? vehachtiv: "hitkoshshu vakoshshu", veamar resh lakish: keshot atzmecha veachar kach keshot acherim!
Hatam ibba deve farzak rufila hava, veamar: i kayytzu – kayetzna, vei la kayytzu – ammay ikkotz. dei mimmatchi lehu – ashlayyhu mistaggi lehu,

a: Vei la – la mistagge lehu.

Rabba bar rav nachman hava ka azel bearba, chaza hahu ibba dekae aggudda denahra. amar lehu: deman? amaru leh: derabba bar rav huna. amar: "veyad hassarim vehasseganim hayta bammaal hazze rishona". amar lehu: kutzu. katztzu.
Ata rabba bar rav huna ashkecheh dekayitz, amar: man katzyeh – tikkotz anfeh. amri kullehu shene derabba bar rav huna, la ikkayyaym leh zara lerabba bar rav nachman.
Amar rav yehuda: hakkol leigle gappa, vaafillu miyyatme – aval rabbanan la. may tama? rabbanan la tzerichi netiruta. lecharya defatya – vaafillu merabbanan.
Vela amaran ella dela nafki bechaloza. aval lechaloza – la, derabbanan lav bene mippak bechaloza ninhu.
Amar rav yehuda: lecharya denahra – tattae mesayyeyi illae, illae la mesayyeyi tattae. vechillufa bemayya demitra.

Tanya name hachi: chamesh gannot hammistappekot mayim mimmayan echad, venitkalkel hammayayn – kullam metakkenot im haelyona. nimtzet hattachtona metakkenet im kullan umetakkenet leatzmah. vechen chamesh chatzerot shehayu mekallechot mayim leviv echad, venitkalkel habbiv – kullan metakkenot im hattachtona, nimtzet haelyona metakkenet im kullan umetakkenet leatzmah.
Amar shemuel: hay man deachzek berakta denahra – chatzifa have, salloke la mesallekinan leh. vehaiddana deka katvi parsae: kene lach ad mele tzavvere suseya mayya – salloke name mesallekinan leh.

Amar rav yehuda amar rav: hay man deachzek bene ache uvene shuttafe, chatzifa have. salloke la mesallekinan leh. verav nachman amar: name mesallekinan. vei mishshum dina devar mitzra – la mesallekinan leh.
Nehardae amri: afillu mishshum dina devar mitzra – mesallekinan leh, mishshum shenneemar: "veasita hayyashar vehattov beene Adonai".

Ata immelich beh, amar leh: ezil ezbon? vaamar leh: zil zevon. tzerich lemikne minneh, o la? ravina amar: la tzerich lemikne minneh, nehardae amri: tzerich lemikne minneh. vehilcheta: tzerich lemikne minneh.
Hasheta deamrat tzerich lemikne minneh, i la keno minneh – iyyaykkur vezul birshuteh.
Zevan bima veshave matan, (chazena) [chazenan]: i lechulle alma ka mozelo umezabben – yahev leh mea veshakel leh. vei la – yahev leh matan veshakel leh.

Zevan bematan veshavya mea, sevur minna, matze amar leh: letakkone shaddartaycha vela leauote. amar leh mar kashshisha bereh derav chisda lerav ashe: hachi amri nehardae mishshum derav nachman: en onaa lekarkaot.
Zabben leh geriva deara bemitza nichseh, chazenan i iddit hi, i zibburit hi – zevineh zevine.
b: Vei la, iarome ka maarem.
Mattana let bah mishshum dina devar mitzra. amar ammemar: i ketav leh achrayut – it bah mishshum dina devar mitzra.
Machar kol nechasav leechad – let ba mishshum dina devar mitzra. livalim harishonim – let ba mishshum dina devar mitzra. zevan miggoy vezabben legoy – let ba mishshum dina devar mitzra.

Zevan miggoy – daamar leh: ari avrachi lach mimmitzrach. zabben legoy – goy vadday lav bar "veasita hayyashar vehattov" hu. shammote vadday meshammetinan leh, ad dimkabbel aleh kol unese deate leh mechamateh.
Mashkanta let ba mishshum dina devar mitzra. deamar rav ashe: amaru li save demata machseya: may "mashkanta" – dishchuna gabbeh. may nafka minna – ledina devar mitzra.
Limkor berachok veligol bekarov, bera veligol beyafe – let ba mishshum dina devar mitzra.

Lichraga velimzone velikvura – let ba mishshum dina devar mitzra. deamri nehardeae: lichraga, limzone velikvura mezabbeninan bela achrazta. leishsha uleyatme uleshuttafe – let ba mishshum dina devar mitzra.
Shechene hair ushechene sade – shechene hair kodmin.
Shachen vetalmid chacham – talmid chacham kodem. karov vetalmid chacham – talmid chacham kodem. ibbaya lehu: shachen vekarov may? ta shema: "tov shachen karov meach rachok".
Hane zuze tave vehane zuze tekule – let beh mishshum dina devar mitzra. hane tzayyri vehane sheru – let beh mishshum dina devar mitzra.
Amar: ezil veetrach veayyte zuze – la natrinan leh. amar: ezil ayyte zuze, chazenan: i gavra daamid hu deazel umayyte zuze – natrinan leh, vei la – la natrinan leh.

Ara dechad uvatte dechad – mare ara meakkev ammare batte, mare batte la meakkev ammare deara. ara dechad vedikle dechad – mare deara matze meakkev ammare dikle, mare dikle la matze meakkev ammare deara.
Ara levatte veara lezara – yishshuv adif, velet ba mishshum dina devar mitzra.
Afsek meshunnita o richba dedikla, (chazena) [chazenan]: im yachol lehachenis bah afillu telem echad – it ba mishshum dina devar mitzra, vei la – let ba mishshum dina devar mitzra.
Hane arbaa bene mitzrane, dekadem chad minnayyhu vezaven – zevineh zevine. vei kullehu atu bahade hadade – palgu la bekarnezil.

a: Mishna hamekabbel sade mechavero leshanim muatot – lo yizraenna pishtan, veen lo bekorot shikma. kibbelah hemennu lesheva shanim – shana rishona yizraenna pishtan, veyesh lo bekorot shikma.
Gemara amar abbaye: bekorot shikma – en lo, bishvach shikma – yesh lo. verava amar: afillu bishvach shikma name en lo.
Metivi: hamekabbel sade mechavero vehiggia zemanno latzet – shamin lo. may lav: shamin lo bishvach shikma? la, shamin lo yarka vesilka.
Yarka vesilka – naakor venishkol! bidla meta yoma deshuka.
Ta shema: hamekabbel sade mechavero vehiggia sheviit, shamin lo. sheviit mi ka mafkea ara? ella ema: hamekabbel sade mechavero vehiggia yovel, shamin lo.
Veakkatti, yovel mi mafkea kabbelanut? "litzmitut" amar rachamana! ella ema: hallokeach sade mechavero vehiggia yovel – shamin lo.
Vechi tema hachi name, shamin lo beyarka vesilka? silka veyarka beyovel hefkera hu! ella lav, shevach shikma!
Targema abbaye allibba derava: shane hatam, deamar kera: "veyatza mimkar bayit". mimkar – chozer, shevach – eno chozer. venigmar minneh? hatam zevine mealleya hu, veyovel afkata demalka hi.

Rav pappa kabbel ara leaspasta. kedachu ba tale. ki ka mistallak, amar lehu: havu li shevacha. amar leh rav shisha bereh derav idi lerav pappa: ella meatta, dikla vaalem, hachi name devae mar shevacheh? amar leh: hatam lav addata dehachi nachet, ana hacha addata dehachi nechetna.
Keman? keabbayye, deamar: bishvach shikma yesh lo. afillu tema kerava, hatam let leh peseda. hacha ikka peseda.

Amar leh: may pesedaych yeda deaspasta, shekol yeda deaspasta vezil! amar leh: ana kurekma rishka rabbay. amar leh: gallet addatach dilmishkal veistalloke avadt – shekol kurekma rishka vezil, en lecha ella deme etzim bilvad.

Rav bivi bar abbaye kabbel ara veahdar leh meshunnita, kedachu beh zardata. ki ka mistallak amar lehu: havu li shevachay. amar rav pappe: mishshum deatetu mimmulae amritu mille muleyayta?! afillu rav pappa la amar ella deit leh peseda, hacha may peseda it lach.

Rav yosef hava leh hahu shattala, shechev ushevak chamsha chatnavota. amar ad haiddana chad, hasheta chamsha. ad haiddana la havo samchu ahadade vela mafsedu li, hasheta chamsha samchu ahadade umafsedu li. amar lehu: i shaklitu shevachayychu umistallekitu – mutav, vei la – mesallekna lechu bela shevacha.
Deamar rav yehuda, veittema rav huna, veittema rav nachman: hay shattala dishchev – yorshin dileh (mistallekin) [mesallekinan] lehu bela shevacha. velav milleta hi.

Hahu shattala daamar lehu: i mafsedyna mistallakna. afsed. amar rav yehuda: mistallak bela shevacha. rav kahana amar: mistallak veshakel shevacha. umode rav kahana dei amar i [ma]fesedna mistallakna bela shevacha, mistallak bela shevacha. rava amar: asmachta hi, veasmachta la kanya.
Ulerava may shena meha ditnan: im ovir vela aaved ashallem bemetva! hatam may deafsed – meshallem, hacha may deafsed – menakkenan leh veiddach yahavinan leh.

Runeya shattala deravina hava afsed. sallekeh ata lekammeh derava. amar leh chazi mar may ka aved li! amar leh: shappir avayd. amar leh: ha lo hitra bi! amar leh: la (tzericha lehaterot) [tzerichat leatroye]. rava letameh, deamar rava: makre dardeke shattala tabbacha veummana
b: Vesafar mata – kullan kemuterin veomdin dame. kelala demilleta: kol peseda dela hadar – kemuterin veomdin dame.

Hahu shattala, daamar lehu: havu li shevachay devaena lemissak leara deyisrael. ata lekammeh derav pappa bar shemuel. amar lehu: havu leh shevacheh. amar leh rava: ihu ashbach, ara la ashbach! amar leh: ana palga dishvacha kaamena lach. amar leh: ad haiddana hava shakel baal habbayit palga veshattala palga. hasheta bae lemittav menata laarisa! amar leh: riva dishvacha kaamena.

Sevar rav ashe lememar "riva" dehu danka. deamar rav minyome bereh derav nechumi: beatra deshakel shattala palga vaarisa tilta, hay shattala devae leistalloke – yahavinan leh shevacha umesallekinan leh ki hechi dela nimteyeh hefsed levaal habbayit.
I amrat bishlama riva dehu danka – shappir, ella i amrat riva mammash, ka mate leh peseda levaal habbayit palga danka!
Amar leh rav acha bereh derav yosef lerav ashe, velema leh: ant menata dilach – hav leh laarisa, vaana menata dili may devaena avedna beh. amar: ki matet lishchitat kodashim, ta veakshi li.

Gufa, amar rav minyome bereh derav nechumi: beatra deshakel shattala palga vaarisa tilta, hay shattala devae istalloke – yahavinan leh shevacheh umesallekinan leh ki hechi dela lifsod baal habbayit. amar rav minyome bereh derav nechumi: kofa sava – palga. shatfa nahara – riva.
Hahu gavra demashken pardesa lechavreh laasar shenin, vekash lachamesh shenin. abbaye amar: pera have. rava amar: karna have, veyillakach bo karka, vehu ochel perot.

Metivi: yavash hailan o niktzatz, shenehem asurim bo. ketzad yaasu? yimmachru leetzim, veyillakach bahen karka, vehu ochel perot. may lav, yavash dumeya deniktzatz: ma niktzatz bizmanno, af yavash bizmanno, vekatane: yillakach bahen karka vehu ochel perot. alma karna have!
La: niktzatz dumeya deyavash, ma yavash belo zemanno – af niktzatz belo zemanno.
Ta shema: naflu lah gefanim vezetim zekenim –

a: Yimmachru leetzim, veyillakach bahen karka, vehu ochel perot. ema: vehizkinu.
Veibbaet ema: lav mi okemna lehahi kegon shennaflu lah besade acheret, deka chalya karna.

Hahu shetara dahava ketiv beh shenin setama. malve amar: shalosh. love amar: shetayim. kedem malve veachlinhu lefere. mi neeman? rav yehuda amar: karka bechezkat bealeha kayyma. rav kahana amar: perot bechezkat ochlehen kayymi.
Vehilcheta kevoteh derav kahana, deamar: perot bechezkat ochlehen kayymi. veha kayyma lan dehilcheta kevoteh derav nachman, deamar: karka bechezkat bealeha omedet!
Hatam – milleta dela avida leiggalloye hi. hacha – milleta daavida leiggalloye hi, veatroche be dina tere zimne la matrechinan.
Malve omer chamesh, love omer shalosh. amar leh: ayyti li shetarach! amar leh: shetara irchas li. amar rav yehuda: malve neeman, miggo dei bae amar lekucha hi beyadi.

Amar leh rav pappa lerav ashe: rav zevid verav avvira la sevira lehu ha derav yehuda. may tama: hay shetara kevan dilguveyayna kae – mizhar zehir beh, umichbash hu dechavsheh lishtareh, savar: ochla tarten shenin yattirta.

Amar leh ravina lerav ashe: ella meatta, hay mashkanta desura dechatvi hachi: "bemishlam shenayya illen tippok ara da bela kesaf". hecha dechavsheh lishtar mashkanta veamar: lekucha hi beyadi, hachi name dimheman? vechi metakkeni rabbanan milleta deate ba [lide] peseda? amar leh: hatam takkinu le rabbanan demare ara yahev taska vechare karya.
Ara delet la karya vela yahev taska, may? amar leh: ibbei leh lemachoye! la (immecha) [machi], may? ihu hu deafsed annafsheh.
Aris omer: lemechetza yaradti, uvaal habbayit omer: lishlish horadtiv, mi neeman? rav yehuda amar: baal habbayit neeman. rav nachman amar: hakkol keminhag hammedina.
Sevur minna la peligi: ha beatra deshakel arisa palga, ha beatra deshakel arisa tilta.
Amar lehu rav mari bera devat shemuel: hachi amar abbaye: afillu beatra deshakel arisa palga peligi, rav yehuda amar: baal habbayit neeman, dei bae amar: sechiri ulekiti hu.
Yetomim omrim: anu hishbachnu, uvaal chov omer: avichem hishbiach, al mi lehavi reaya?
b: Savar rabbi chanina lememar: ara bechezkat yatme kayyma, veal baal chov lehavi reaya. amar lehu hahu sava, hachi amar rabbi yochanan: al hayyetomim lehavi reaya. may tama? ara, kevan dilguveyayna kayyma – keman degavya damya, veal hayyetomin lehavi reaya.
Amar abbaye, af anan name tenena: safek ze kadam vesafek ze kadam – kotzetz veeno noten damim.
Alma kevan dilmikkatz kayyma, amrinan leh: ayyti reaya ushekol. hachi name, hay shetara kevan dilguveyayna kayyma – keman degavya damya, veal hayyetomim lehavi reaya.
Ayyto yatme reaya deinhu ashbachu, savar rabbi chanina lememar: ki mesallekinan lehu – beara mesallekinan lehu.
Vela hi, bidme mesallekinan lehu, midderav nachman. deamar rav nachman amar shemuel: shelosha shamin lahem et hashshevach, umaalin otan bedamim, veellu hen: bechor lefashut,
Uvaal chov uchetubbat ishsha litomim, uvaal chov lelakochot.

Amar leh ravina lerav ashe: lememra desavar shemuel baal chov lelakochot? umay it leh shevacha lelokeach? vehaamar shemuel baal chov gove et hashshevach! vechi tema, la kashya: kan – beshevach hammaggia lichtefayim, kan – beshevach sheen maggia lakketefayim. veha maasim bechol yom, veka magbe shemuel afillu beshevach hammaggia lichtefayim!
La kashya: ha demassek beh keshiur ara ushevacha, ha dela massek beh shiur ara ushevacha.

Vechi la massek shiur ara ushevacha, deyahev leh zuze lelokeach umesallek leh, hanicha leman deamar: i it leh zuze lelokeach la matze mesallek leh levaal chov – shappir. ella leman deamar: it leh zuze lelokeach matze mesallek leh levaal chov, venema leh: i havo li zuze – hava mesallekna lach mikkulla ara, hasheta delet li zuze – hav li geriva deara bearay shiur shevachay!
Hacha bemay askinan – kegon deshavveya nihaleh appoteke, daamar leh: lo yehe lecha peraon ella mizzo.
Mishna hamekabbel sade mechavero leshavua echad bishva meot zuz, hashsheviit min hamminyan. kibbelah hemennu sheva shanim bishva meot zuz – en hashsheviit min hamminyan.

Sechir yom – gove kol hallayla. sechir layla – gove kol hayyom. sechir shaot – gove kol hallayla vechol hayyom. sechir shabbat, sechir chodesh, sechir shana, sechir shavua, yatza bayyom – gove kol hayyom, yatza ballayla – gove kol hallayla vechol hayyom.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: minnayin lischir yom sheggove kol hallayla? talmud lomar: "lo talin peullat sachir ittecha ad boker". uminnayin lischir layla sheggove kol hayyom – shenneemar: "beyomo titten secharo".
Veema ippecha! sechirut enah mishtallemet ella bassof.
Tanu rabbanan: mimmashma shenneemar "lo talin peullat sachir ittecha", eni yodea shead boker"? ma talmud lomar "ad boker" – melammed sheeno over ella ad boker rishon bilvad.
Mikkan veelach, may? amar rav: over mishshum "bal teshahe". amar rav yosef: may keraa – "al tomar lereacha lech vashuv umachar etten veyesh ittach".
Tanu rabbanan: haomer lachavero tze sechor li poalim – shenehen en ovrin mishshum "bal talin". ze, lefi shello secharan,

a: Veze, lefi sheen peullato etzlo. hechi dame? i daamar lehu secharchem alay – secharo alav hu, detanya: hassocher et happoel laasot beshello veherahu beshel chavero – noten lo secharo mishshalem, vechozer venotel mibbaal habbayit ma shehehena oto!
La tzericha, daamar lehu: secharchem al baal habbayit.
Yehuda bar marimar amar leh leshammaeh: zil egor li poalim, veema lehu: secharchem al baal habbayit, marimar umar zutera agri lahadade.
Amar rabba bar rav huna: hane shukae desura la avri mishshum "bal talin", midda yadi deal yoma deshuka semichi, aval mishshum "bal teshahe" vadday over.

Sechir shaot gove kol hallayla vechol hayyom. amar rav: sechir shaot deyom – gove kol hayyom, sechir shaot delayla – gove kol hallayla. ushemuel amar: sechir shaot deyom – gove kol hayyom, usechir shaot delayla – gove kol hallayla vechol hayyom.
Tenan: sechir shaot gove kol hallayla vechol hayyom, teyuveta derav! amar lecha rav: litzdadin katane. sechir shaot deyom – gove kol hayyom, sechir shaot delayla – gove kol hallayla.
Tenan: haya sechir shabbat, sechir chodesh, sechir shana, sechir shavua, yotze bayyom – gove kol hayyom. yotze ballayla – gove kol hallayla vechol hayyom.

Amar lecha rav: tannae hi, detanya: sechir shaot deyom – gove kol hayyom, sechir shaot delayla – gove kol hallayla, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi shimon omer: sechir shaot deyom – gove kol hayyom, sechir shaot delayla – gove kol hallayla vechol hayyom.

Mikkan amru: kol hakkovesh sechar sachir, over bachamishsha shemot hallalu vaase. mishshum "bal taashok et reacha", umishshum "bal tigzol", umishshum "bal taashok sachir ani", umishshum "bal talin", umishshum "beyomo titten secharo", umishshum "lo tavo alav hashshemesh".
Hane deikka bimama – lekka belelya, deikka belelya – lekka bimama? amar rav chisda: shem sechirut bealma.
Eze hu oshek veezehu gazel? amar rav chisda: "lech vashuv", "lech vashuv" – ze hu oshek. "yesh lecha beyadi veeni noten lecha" – ze hu gazel.

Matkef la rav sheshet: ezehu oshek shechiyyeyva alav tora korban – dumeya defikkadon, deka chafar leh mamona! ella amar rav sheshet: "netattiv lach" – zehu oshek, "yesh lecha beyadi veeni noten lach" – ze hu gazel.
Matkef la abbaye: eze hu gazel shechiyyeyva alav tora korban, dumeya defikkadon baenan, deka chafar leh mamona! ella amar abbaye: "lo secharticha meolam" – ze hu oshek, "netattiv lach" – ze hu gazel.
Ulerav sheshet, may shena oshek dekashya leh, umay shena gazel dela kashya leh? amar lach: gazel – degazleh vahadar kafreh.
I hachi, afillu oshek name dahadar kafreh! hachi hasheta: bishlama hatam ketiv: "o vegazel" – mikkelal deodi leh meikkara. aval gabbe oshek mi ketiv "o veoshek"? "o ashak" ketiv, sheashako kevar.
Rava amar: ze hu oshek zehu gazel. velamma chillekan hakkatuv – laavor alav bishne lavin.

Mishna echad sechar adam veechad sechar behema veechad sechar kelim – yesh bo mishshum "beyomo titten secharo", veyesh bo mishshum "lo talin peullat sachir ittecha ad boker". ematay – bizman shettevao. lo tevao – eno over alav. himchahu etzel chenvani o etzel shulechani – eno over alav.
Sachir bizmanno – nishba venotel. avar zemanno – eno nishba venotel. im yesh edim shettevao bizmanno – hare ze nishba venotel.
Ger toshav yesh bo mishshum "beyomo titten secharo", veen bo mishshum "lo talin peullat sachir ittecha ad boker".
Gemara manni matnitin? la tanna kamma demeachecha", vela rabbi yose berabbi yehuda. may hi, detanya:
b: "Meachecha" – perat laacherim. "gercha" – ze ger tzedek. "bisharecha" – ze ochel nevelot.
En li ella sechar adam, minnayin lerabbot behema vechelim? talmud lomar: "beartzecha" – kol shebbeartzecha. vechullan ovrim bechol hashshemot hallalu.

Mikkan amru: echad sechar adam veechad sechar behema veechad sechar kelim – yesh bo mishshum "beyomo titten secharo", veyesh bahen mishshum "bal talin peullat sachir". rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer: ger toshav yesh bo mishshum "beyomo titten secharo", veen bo mishshum "lo talin". behema vechelim en bahen ella mishshum "bal taashok" bilvad.
Manni? i tanna kamma demeachecha" – kashya ger toshav. i rabbi yose – kashya behema vechelim!

Amar rava: hay tanna – tanna deve rabbi yishmael hu, detana deve rabbi yishmael: echad sechar adam, veechad sechar behema veechad sechar kelim – yesh bo mishshum "beyomo titten secharo" umishshum "lo talin". ger toshav – yesh bo mishshum "beyomo titten secharo", veen bo mishshum "bal talin".
May tama detanna kamma "demeachecha" – gamar "sachir" "sachir". verabbi yose berabbi yehuda la gamar "sachir" "sachir".

Nehi dela gamar "sachir" "sachir", behema vechelim mishshum "beyomo titten secharo" name nichayyayv? tane rabbi chananya, amar kera: "velo tavo alav hashshemesh ki ani hu" – mi shehen bain lide aniyyut vaashirut, yatzu behema vechelim sheenan bain lide aniyyut vaashirut.
Vetanna kamma, hay "ki ani hu" may aved leh? hahu mibbee: lehakedim ani leashir. verabbi yose berabbi yehuda: hahu "millo taashok sachir ani veevyon" nafka.
Vetanna kamma: chad lehakedim ani leashir, vechad lehakedim ani leevyon.
Utzericha, dei ashmeinan evyon – mishshum dela kesif lemitbeeh. aval ashir, dichsif lemitbeeh – ema la. vei ashmeinan ashir – mishshum dela tzerich leh, aval evyon ditzrich leh – ema la, tzericha.
Vetanna didan: ma nafshach? i yalef "sachir" "sachir" – afillu ger toshav name, i la yalef "sachir" "sachir" – behema vechelim mena leh?

Leolam la yalef "sachir" "sachir", veshane hatam deamar kera "velo talin peullat sachir ittecha ad boker": kol sheppeullato ittecha. i hachi, afillu ger toshav name! amar kera "reacha" – reacha, velo ger toshav.

I hachi, afillu behema vechelim name! ha ketiv "ittecha". ma raita lerabbot behema vechelim ulehotzi ger toshav? mistabbera behema vechelim hava leh lerabbot – shekken yeshnan bichlal mamon reacha, ger toshav eno bichlal mamon reacha.
Vetanna kamma demeachecha" [ver yose ber yehuda], hay "reacha" may avdi leh? hahu mibbee leh lechidtanya: "reacha" velo goy. goy meachecha" nafka!

Chad lemishre oshko, vechad lemishre gezelo, veka savar gezel goy muttar. utzerichi: dei ashmeinan gezelo – mishshum dela tarach beh, aval oshko, detarach beh – ema la. vei ashmeinan oshko – mishshum dela ata lideh, aval gezelo, daata lideh – ema la. tzericha.

Verabbi yose berabbi yehuda, hay "lo talin peullat sachir ittecha ad boker" may aved leh? mibbaya leh lechidrav assi. deamar rav assi: afillu lo secharo ella livtzor lo eshkol echad shel anavim – over mishshum "bal talin".
Veiddach: mivelav hu nose et nafsho" nafka, davar hammoser nafsho alav.

a: Veiddach: hahu mibbee leh lechidtanya: "veelav hu nose et nafsho", mippene ma ala ze bakkevesh venitla bailan umasar et atzmo lemita – lo al secharo?
Davar acher: "veelav hu nose et nafsho", kol hakkovesh sechar sachir – keillu notel nafsho mimmennu. rav huna verav chisda, chad amar: nafsho shel gazlan, vechad amar: nafsho shel nigzal.

Man deamar nafsho shel gazlan, dichtiv: "al tigzol dal ki dal hu veal tedakke ani vashshaar", uchetiv: "ki Adonai yariv rivam vekava et kovehem nafesh". uman deamar nafsho shel nigzal, dichtiv: "ken orchot kol botzea batza et nefesh bealav yikkach".
Veiddach name, hachtiv "et nefesh bealav yikkach"! bealav dehashta. veiddach name, hachtiv: "vekava et kovehem nafesh"! ma taam kaamar: ma taam "kava et kovehem" – mishshum denatlu nafesh.
Ematay – bizman shettevao, lo tevao – eno over alav. tanu rabbanan: "lo talin peullat sachir" yachol afillu lo tevao – talmud lomar: "ittecha", ledatecha.
Yachol afillu en lo – talmud lomar: "ittecha". sheyyesh ittecha. yachol afillu himchahu etzel chenvani veetzel shulechani, talmud lomar: "ittecha" velo shehimchahu etzel chenvani veetzel shulechani.
Himchahu etzel chenvani veetzel shulechani – eno over. ibbaya lehu: chozer, o eno chozer? rav sheshet amar: eno chozer, verabba amar: chozer.
Amar rabba: mena amena la – middekatane: eno over alav, mibar hu dela avar, ha mihdar hadar. verav sheshet amar: may eno over – eno betorat laavor.
Beo minneh merav sheshet: kabbelanut, over alav mishshum "bal talin", o en over mishshum "bal talin"?
Umman kone bishvach keli, vehalevaa hi? o en umman kone bishvach keli, usechirut hi?
Amar lehu rav sheshet: over! vehatanya: eno over! hatam shehimchahu etzel chenvani veetzel shulechani.

Nema mesayyeya leh: hannoten tallito leumman, gemarah vehodio, afillu mikkan vead asara yamim, eno over mishshum "bal talin". netanah lo bachatzi hayyom – mishsheshshaka alav chamma over mishshum "bal talin".
Vei amrat umman kone bishvach keli – ammay over?
Amar rav mari bereh derav kahana: bigrada desarbala. lemay yahave nihaleh – lerakkoche, hayeynu shevacheh.
La tzericha, deka agreh (minneh) levattoshe bitsha uvitsha bemaata.
b: Sachir bizmanno nishba venotel vechulei. sachir ammay takkinu le rabbanan (lemishteva) [demishteva] veshakel?
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: halachot gedolot shanu kan. hane hilcheta ninhu? hane takkanot ninhu! ella amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: takkanot gedolot shanu kan. "gedolot", mikkelal deikka ketannot?

Ella amar rav nachman amar shemuel: takkanot kevuot shanu kan. shevua devaal habbayit hi, veakruha rabbanan lishvua devaal habbayit veshadyuha assachir, mishshum kede chayyav desachir. umishshum kede chayyav desachir (mafsedna) [mafsedinan] leh levaal habbayit?

Baal habbayit gufeh nicha leh demishteva sachir veshakel, ki hechi delittagru leh poalim. sachir gufeh nicha leh demishteva baal habbayit venifka, ki hechi deligru baal habbayit? al kurcheh agar. sachir name beal kurcheh (ittegar)!
Ella baal habbayit tarud befoalim hu. i hachi nittev leh bela shevua! kede lehafis dato shel baal habbayit.
Venittev leh beedim? tericha lehu milleta. venittev leh meikkara? shenehem rotzim behakkafa.
I hachi, afillu katzatz name! allema tanya, umman omer: shetayim katzatzta li, vehalla omer: lo katzatzti lecha ella achat – hammotzi mechavero alav haraya. ketzitza vadday midkar dechiri la inashe.
I hachi, afillu avar zemanno name, allema tenan: avar zemanno – eno nishba venotel? chazaka: en baal habbayit over mishshum "bal talin".
Veha amrat baal habbayit tarud befoalav hu! hane mille – mikkamme delimteyeh zeman chiyyuveh,

a: Aval meta zeman chiyyuveh – rame annafsheh umiddechar.

Vechi sachir over mishshum "bal tigzol"? hatam tere chazake, hacha chada chazaka. gabbe baal habbayit ikka tere chazake: chada deen baal habbayit over mishshum "bal talin", vachada deen sachir meshahe secharo. vehacha chada chazaka.
Im yesh edim shettevao – hare ze nishba venotel. veha (katavo lekamman) [ka tava leh kamman]? amar rabbi assi: shettevao bizmanno. vedilma levatar hachi pera? amar abbaye: shettevao kol zemanno.
Uleolam la para leh?! amar rav chama bar ukeva: keneged oto hayyom shel tevia.
Mishna hammalve et chavero – lo yemashkenennu ella bevet din. velo yikkanes leveto littol mashkono, shenneemar: "bachutz taamod". hayu lo shene chelim – notel echad umanniach echad.

Umachzir et hakkar ballayla veet hammachresha bayyom. veim met – eno machzir leyorshav. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: af leatzmo eno machzir ella ad sheloshim yom, umishsheloshim yom ulehallan mochran bevet din.
Gemara amar shemuel: sheliach bet din menattach nattoche – in, aval mashkone – la. vehatnan: hammalve et chavero lo yemashkenennu ella bevet din, mikkelal divvet din memashkenin!

Amar lach shemuel: ema, lo yenattechennu ella bevet din. hachi name mistabbera, dekatane sefa: lo yikkanes leveto littol mashkono. manni? illema baal chov – meresha shamat minna! ella lav, sheliach bet din!

I mishshum ha – la irya. hachi kaamar: hammalve et chavero lo yemashkenennu ella bevet din, mikkelal divvet din memashkenim, uvaal chov afillu nattoche name la, shello yikkanes leveto littol mashkono.

Metiv rav yosef: "la yachavol rechayim varachev", ha devarim acherim – chavol. "lo tachavol beged almana", ha shel acherim – tachbol, man? i nema baal chov, ha ketiv: "lo tavo el beto laavot avoto", ella lav sheliach bet din!
Targema rav pappa bereh derav nachman kammeh derav yosef, veamri la rav pappa bereh derav yosef kammeh derav yosef: leolam bevaal chov, velaavor alav bishne lavin.
Ta shema: mimmashma shenneemar "bachutz taamod" eni yodea shehaish asher atta noshe vo yotzi"! ella ma talmud lomar "vehaish" – lerabbot sheliach bet din. may lav: sheliach bet din kelove?
b: La, sheliach bet din kemalve.

Ta shema: "im chavol tachbol salmat reecha" – bishliach bet din hakkatuv medabber. atta omer bishliach bet din hakkatuv medabber, o eno ella bevaal chov? keshehu omer "lo tavo el beto laavot avoto" – hare baal chov amur, ha ma ani mekayyem "im chavol tachbol salmat reecha" – bishliach bet din hakkatuv medabber!
Tannae hi, detanya: sheliach bet din shebba lemashkeno – lo yikkanes leveto lemashkeno, ella omed mibbachutz, vehalla motzi lo mashkon, shenneemar "bachutz taamod vehaish".

Vetanya iddach: baal chov shebba lemashkeno – lo yikkanes leveto lemashkeno, ella omed bachutz, vehalla nichnas umotzi lo mashkono, shenneemar: "bachutz taamod". usheliach bet din shebba lemashkeno – hare ze nichnas leveto umemashkeno.
Velo yemashkenennu devarim sheosin bahen ochel nefesh. venoten mitta umitta umatztza – leashir. mitta umitta umappatz – leani. lo – aval lo leishto, velo levanav velivnotav.
Kederech shemmesadderin levaal chov – kach mesadderin baarachin. kelappe leyay?! ikkar siddur – baarachin ketiv! ella ema: kederech shemmesadderin baarachin – kach mesadderin bevaal chov.
Amar mar: noten mitta umitta umatztza leashir, mitta umitta umappatz leani. leman? ilema leishto ulevanav velivnotav – ha amrat, lo, aval lo leishto ulevanav velivnotav! ella idde veidde ledideh.

Tarte lema li? chada deachel ala vachada dezag ala, kedishmuel. deamar shemuel: kol mille yadana asutayyhu, levar mehane telat: man deachel ahina merira allibba rekana, man deasar mitna dechittana rattiva achartzeh, uman deachel nahama vela mesagge arbea garmide.

Tane tanna kammeh derav nachman: kederech shemmesadderin baarachin – kach mesadderin bevaal chov. amar leh: hasheta zabbone mezabbeninan leh, saddore mesadderinan leh?! umi mezabbeninan leh? vehatnan: machzir et hakkar ballayla, veet hammachresha bayyom!

Tanna kerabban shimon ben gamliel tanna kammeh, vehachi kaamar leh: hasheta lerabban shimon ben gamliel zabbone mezabbeninan leh, saddore mesadderinan leh? ditnan, rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: af leatzmo eno machzir ella ad sheloshim yom, mikkan veelach mochran bevet din.

Umimmay dechi kaamar rabban shimon ben gamliel zabbone – ligmare kaamar? dilma hachi kaamar: ad sheloshim yom [ma]hedar leh beeneh, mikkan veelach mayhdar leh lemay dachaze leh, umezabbeninan may dela chaze leh?

I salka datach it leh lerabban shimon ben gamliel hay sevara, lekka midde dela chaze leh. deamar abbaye: rabban shimon ben gamliel, verabbi shimon, verabbi yishmael, verabbi akiva – kullehu sevira lehu: kol yisrael bene melachim hen.
Rabban shimon ben gamliel, ditnan: lo et halluf vela et hachardal. rabban shimon ben gamliel mattir balluf, mippene shehu maachol leorvin.
Rabbi shimon, ditnan: bene melachim sachin shemen vevred al gabbe makkotehen beshabbat, shekken darkan lasuch bachol. rabbi shimon omer: kol yisrael bene melachim hen.

Rabbi yishmael verabbi akiva, detanya: hare shehayu noshin bo elef zuz velavush itztela bat mea mane – mafshitin otah mimmennu umalbishim oto itztela haruya lo. vetana mishshum rabbi yishmael, vetana mishshum rabbi akiva: kol yisrael reuyin leotah itztela.

Ulemay dislek addatin meikkara, deyahev leh may dachaze leh, umezabbeninan may dela chaze leh? bishlama kar vacheset chaze leh devene bene. ella machresha lemay chazya? amar rava bar rabba: machresha dechaspa.
Matkef la rav chagga: velema leh, lav alay karmet? amar leh abbaye:

a: Ivra aleh karme, mishshum shenneemar: "ulecha tihye tzedaka".
Ibbaya lehu: mahu sheyyesadderu bevaal chov? mi gamar "micha" "micha" mearachin, o la?
Ta shema, dishlach ravin beiggarteh: davar ze shaalti lechol rabbotay, velo amru li davar. beram kach hayta sheela: haomer "hare alay mane levedek habbayit", mahu sheyyesadderu?

Rabbi yaakov mishshemeh devar padda, verabbi yirmeya mishshemeh deilfa amri: kal vachomer mibbaal chov. uma baal chov shemmachzirin – en mesadderin, hekdesh sheen machzirin – eno din sheen mesadderin! verabbi yochanan amar: "neder beerkecha" ketiv, ma arachin mesadderin – af hekdesh mesadderin.
Veiddach: hahu leniddon bichvodo hu daata. ma arachin niddon bichvodo – af hekdesh niddon bichvodo.
Visadderu bevaal chov kal vachomer mearachin: uma arachin sheen machzirin – mesadderin, baal chov shemmachzirin – eno din shemmesadderin? amar kera: "veim mach hu meerkecha" – "hu" velo baal chov.
Veiddach: hay, ad sheyyehe bemachuto mittechillato vead sofo.

Veyachziru behekdesh kal vachomer mibbaal chov: uma baal chov sheen mesadderin – machzirin, hekdesh shemmesadderin – eno din shemmachzirin? amar kera: "veshachav besalmato uverchekka", yatza hekdesh, sheen tzarich beracha.
Vela? vehachtiv: "veachalta vesavata uverachta vegomer"! ella amar kera: "ulecha tihye tzedaka", mi shetztzarich tzedaka, yatza hekdesh sheen tzarich tzedaka.

Ashkecheh rabba bar avu leeliyyahu dekae bevet hakkevarot shel goyim, amar leh: mahu sheyyesadderu bevaal chov? amar leh: gamar "micha" "micha" mearachin. gabbe arachin ketiv "veim mach hu meerkecha", gabbe baal chov ketiv "vechi yamuch achicha".
b: Minnayin learom shello yitrom? dichtiv: "velo yire vecha ervat davar".

Amar leh: lav kohen hu mar? may tama kae mar bevet hakkevarot! amar leh: la matne mar teharot? detanya, rabbi shimon ben yochay omer: kivrehen shel nochrim en metammein, shenneemar: "veatten tzoni tzon mariti adam attem". attem keruyin "adam", veen nochrim keruyin "adam".
Amar leh: bearbea la matzena, beshitta matzena? amar leh: veammay? amar leh: dechika li milleta. davreh veayyeyleh legan eden. amar leh: peshot gelimach, sefi shekol mehane tarfe. sefa shekal.
Ki hava nafek, shema dekaamar: man ka achel lealmeh kerabba bar avu. nefatz shedanhu. afillu hachi atyeh liglimeh, sechat gelima recha. zabbeneh bitresar alfe dinare, palginhu lechatnavoteh.

Tanu rabbanan: "veim ish ani hu lo tishkav baavoto", ha ashir – shechayv. may kaamar? amar rav sheshet: hachi kaamar: "veim ish ani hu" – lo tishkav vaavoto etzlecha. ha ashir – shechav vaavoto etzlecha.

Tanu rabbanan: hammalve et chavero eno rashshay lemashkeno, veeno chayyayv lehachezir lo, veover bechol hashshemot hallalu. may kaamar? amar rav sheshet: hachi kaamar, hammalve et chavero eno rashshay lemashkeno, veim mishkeno – chayyayv lehachezir lo. veover bechol hashshemot hallalu – assefa.

Rava amar: hachi kaamar: hammalve et chavero eno rashshay lemashkeno, veim mishkeno – chayyayv lehachezir lo. bamme devarim amurim – shemmishkeno shello bishat halevaato, aval mishkeno bishat halevaato – eno chayyayv lehachezir lo. veover bechol hashshemot hallalu – aresha.

Tane rav shezvi kammeh derava: "ad bo hashshemesh teshivennu lo" – zo kesut layla, "hashev tashiv lo et haavot kevo hashshemesh" – zo kesut yom. amar leh: dimama belelya lema li, udelelya bimama lema li?

Amar leh: ismeyay? amar leh: la, hachi kaamar: "ad bo hashshemesh teshivennu lo" – zo kesut yom shennittena lachavol ballayla, "hashev tashiv lo et haavot kevo hashshemesh" – zo kesut layla shennittena lachavol bayyom.

Amar rabbi yochanan: mishkeno umet, shomto meal gabbe vanav. metivi, amar rabbi meir: vechi meachar shemmemashkenin lamma machzirin? lamma machzirin?! rachamana amar ahdar! ella: meachar shemmachzirin,

a: Lamma chozrin umemashkenin? shello tehe sheviit meshammatto, velo yease mittaltelin etzel banav.
Tama dahadar umashkeneh, ha la hadar umashkeneh – la!
Amar rav adda bar matna: velav tarotze ka metartzat la? taretz hachi: vechi meachar shemmachzirin lamma memashkenin meikkara – shello tehe sheviit meshammatto, velo yease mittaltelin etzel banav.
Tanu rabbanan: "lo tavo el beto laavot avoto". leveto i atta nichnas, aval atta nichnas leveto shel arev. vechen hu omer: "lekach bigdo ki arav zar vegomer".
Veomer: "beni im aravta lereecha takata lazzar kappecha. nokashta veimre ficha nilkadta beimre ficha. ase zot efo beni vehinnatzel ki vata vechaf reecha lech hitrappes urehav reecha".
Im mamon yesh lo beyadecha – hatter lo pissat yad, veim lav – harebe alav reim.
Letzad sheni – leveto i atta nichnas, aval atta nichnas lischar kattaf, lischar chammar, lischar punedak, lischar deyoknaot. yachol afillu zekafan alav bemilve? talmud lomar: "mashshat meuma".
Mishna almana, ben shehi aniyyay ben shehi ashira – en memashkenin otah, shenneemar: "velo tachavol beged almana".
Gemara tanu rabbanan: almana, ben shehi aniyyay ben shehi ashira – en memashkenin otah, divre rabbi yehuda.
Rabbi shimon omer: ashira – memashkenin otah, aniyyay – en memashkenin otah. sheatta chayyayv lehachazir la, veatta massiah shem ra bishchenoteha.
Lememra derabbi yehuda la daresh tama dikra, verabbi shimon daresh tama dikra? veha ippecha shaminan lehu.

Detanya: "velo yarbe lo nashim", rabbi yehuda omer: marbe hu, uvilvad shello yehu mesirot et libbo. rabbi shimon omer: afillu achat vehi mesira et libbo, hare ze lo yissaenna. im ken, ma talmud lomar "velo yarbe lo nashim" – afillu kaavigayil!
Leolam rabbi yehuda la daresh tama dikra, veshane hacha, dimfaresh kera "velo yarbe lo nashim velo yasur". may tama "lo yarbe lo nashim" – mishshum delo yasur".

Verabbi shimon mikkede bealma darshinan tama dikra, lichtov rachamana "lo yarbe", vela baenan "lo yasur"! vaana yadana: may tama "lo yarbe" – mishshum delo yasur". "lo yasur" dichtav rachamana lema li? afillu achat umesira et libbo – hare ze lo yissaenna.

Mishna hachovel et harechayim – over mishshum lo taase, vechayyayv mishshum shene kelim, shenneemar: "lo yachavol rechayim varachev". velo rechayim varechev bilvad amru, ella kol davar sheosin bo ochel nefesh, shenneemar: "ki nefesh hu chovel".

Gemara amar rav huna: chaval rechayim – loke shetayim: mishshum "rechayim", umishshum "ki nefesh hu chovel". rechayim varechev – loke shalosh: mishshum "rechayim", "varechev", umishshum "ki nefesh hu chovel".
Verav yehuda amar: chaval rechayim – loke achat, verechev – loke achat, rechayim varechev – loke shetayim. "ki nefesh hu chovel" –
b: Lishar devarim hu daata.
Lema abbaye verava, biflugeta derav huna verav yehuda kamippalgi?

Deamar rava: achal na – loke shetayim: mishshum "na", umishshum "ki im tzeli esh". mevushshal – loke shetayim: mishshum "mevushshal", umishshum "ki im tzeli esh". na umevushshal – loke shalosh: mishshum "na", umishshum "mevushshal", umishshum "lo tochlennu ki im tzeli esh".
Abbaye amar: en lokin al lav shebbichlalot. lema abbaye deamar kerav yehuda, verava deamar kerav huna?
Amar lach rava: ana daamari afillu kerav yehuda, ad kan la kaamar rav yehuda hatam, ella dechi nefesh hu chovel" la mashma rechayim varechev, hilkach lishar devarim hu daata.
Aval hacha "ki im tzeli esh" lemay ata? shema minna lelav.
Veabbaye amar lach: ana daamari afillu lerav huna: ad kan la kaamar rav huna hatam, ella dechi nefesh hu chovel"

a: Yattira hu, kevan deyattira hu – shidyeh arechayim varachev.
Aval hacha, "ki im tzeli esh" lav yattira hu, demibbee leh lechidtanya: beshaa sheyyeshno bekum echol tzali, yeshno – beval tochal na. beshaa sheeno bekum echol tzali – eno beval tochal na.
Tanya kevoteh derav yehuda: chaval zug shel sapparim vetzemed shel parot – chayyayv shetayim. ze beatzmo veze beatzmo – eno chayyayv ella achat.

Vetanya iddach: chaval zug shel sapparim vetzemed shel parot, yachol lo yehe chayyayv ella achat – talmud lomar "lo yachavol rechayim varachev". ma rechayim varechev shehen meyuchadin shene kelim veosin melacha achat, vechayyayv al ze bifne atzmo veal ze bifne atzmo – af kol devarim shehen shene kelim meyuchadim veosin melacha achat – chayyayv al ze bifne atzmo veal ze bifne atzmo.

Hahu gavra dachaval sakkina deashkavta mechavreh. ata lekammeh deabbaye, amar leh: zil ahdereh, dehave leh keli sheosim bo ochel nefesh, veta kum bedina ale. rava amar: la tzerich lemekam bedina ale, veyachol liton ad kede demehen.
Veabbaye let leh hahi sevara: may shena mehanhu izze deachli chushela binhardea, vaata mara dechushela utefas lehu veka taen tuva. vaamar avu dishmuel yachol liton ad kede demehen!

Hatam lav midde (daavida) [daavid] leoshole uleogore hu. hacha midde daavid leoshole uleogore hu. dishlach rav huna bar avin: devarim haasuyin lehasheil ulehaskir, veamar lekuchin hen beyadi – eno neeman.
Verava let leh hay sevara? veha rava appek zuga desarbala vesifra deaggadta miyyatme bidvarim haasuyin lehasheil ulehaskir! amar lach rava: hay name, kevan demippagma – kafdi inashe vela moshli.
Hadaran alach hamekabbel
b: Mishna habbayit vehaaliyyay shel shenayim, shennaflu – shenehem cholkin baetzim uvaavanim uveafar. veroin ellu avanim haasuyot lehishtabber. im haya echad mehen makkir miktzat avanav – notlan, veolot lo min hacheshbon.
Gemara middekatane roin – mikkelal deikka lemekam alayyhu, i bechavsa nefil, i bechavta nefil.
I hachi, resha ammay cholkin? nechze i bechavta nefil – illayayta ittevur, i bechavsa nefil – tattayayta ittevur!
La tzericha, dinfil belelya. velechzinhu betzafra? defanninhu. velichze man panninhu uleshayyleh? defanninhu bene reshut harabbim, vaazalu lealma.

Velichze birshuta[1] deman yatvan, velihve iddach hammotzi mechavero alav haraya! la tzericha, deyaytvan bechatzer detarvayyhu, i name birshut harabbim. veibbaet ema: shuttafin bechi hay gavvna la kafdi ahadade.
Im haya echad mehen makkir kulei. vehalla ma toen? i dekaamar in – peshita! vei la amar in, lamma notel?! ella deamar leh eni yodea.
Lema tihve teyuveta derav nachman, deittemar: mane li beyadcha, vehalla omer: eni yodea. rav huna verav yehuda amri: chayyayv. rav nachman verabbi yochanan amri: patur.
Kidamar rav nachman: kegon sheyyesh esek shevua benehen. hacha name: kegon sheyyesh esek shevua benehen.
Hechi dame esek shevua? kidrava. deamar rava: mane li beyadcha, vehalla omer: en lecha beyadi ella chamishshim, vehashshear eni yodea. mittoch sheeno yachol lishshava – yeshallem.
Veolot lo min hacheshbon. savar rava lememar lefi cheshbon shevurot. alma kevan deamar eni yodea, ria tefe.
Amar leh abbaye: adderabba, ha ria tefe. middehane yada, tefe la yada – tu let leh, veiddach kullehu dehaych ninhu!
Ella amar abbaye: lefi cheshbon shelemot. i hachi may kamhanne leh? lemalbena ravvcha. i name tina dimabbeda.
Mishna habbayit vehaaliyyay. nifchata haaliyyay, veen baal habbayit rotze letakken – hare baal haaliyyay yored vedar lematta, ad sheyyetakken lo et haaliyyay.
Rabbi yose omer: hattachton noten et hattikra, vehaelyon et hammaaziva.
Gemara nifchata bechamma? rav amar: berubbah, ushemuel amar: bearbaa.
Rav amar: berubbah, aval bearbaa – lo: adam dar chetzyo lematta vechetzyo lemala. ushemuel amar, bearbaa: en adam dar chetzyo lematta vechetzyo lemala.
Hechi dame? i deamar aliyyay zo – azada! ella daamar leh aliyyay setam – logar leh achariti.
Amar rava, la tzericha daamar leh: aliyyay zo sheani maskir lach, ki salka – selek bahada, vechi nachayta[1] – chut bahada. i hachi, may lememra?
Ella amar rav ashe, daamar leh: "aliyyay zo sheal gabbe bayit ze ani maskir lach", deha shabed bayit laaliyyay.

Vechi ha deamar ravin bar rav adda amar rabbi yitzchak: maase beechad sheamar lachavero "dalit sheal gabbe parsek ze ani mocher lach", veneekar happarsek. uva maase lifne rabbi chiyyay, veamar: chayyayv atta lehaamid lo parsek kol zeman shehaddalit kayyemet.
Bae rabbi abba bar memel:

a: Keshehu dar, levaddo hu dar kidmeikkara, o dilma shenehem darin, daamar leh: addata leappokinan la ogari lach.

Im timtza lomar shenehem darin bo, keshehu mishtammesh – derech petachim mishtammesh, o derech gaggin mishtammesh? mi amar kidmeikkara: ma meikkara, derech gaggin – hasheta name derech gaggin. o dilma matze amar leh: aliyyay – kabbeli alay, aliyyay virida – la kabbeli alay.
Im timtza lomar, matze amar leh: aliyyay virida la kabbeli alay. shete aliyyot zo al gav zo, mahu? ippechit elyona, nachet vedar betachtona. ippechit tachtona, mahu lemislak ligmare beelyona?
Mi amrinan daamar leh: shem aliyyay kabbelyt alach? o dilma: chad aliyyay – kabbel aleh, shete aliyyot – la kabbel aleh? teku.

Rabbi yose omer: hattachton noten et hattikra kulei. may "tikra"? rabbi yose bar chanina amar: kinnim usenain. v[yu]setini amar rabbi shimon ben lakish: levochim. vela peligi: mar ki atreh umar ki atreh.

Hanhu be tere dahavo dayyri, chad illay vechad tattay. ippechit maaziva. ki mashe mayya, illay azli umazzeki letattay. mi metakken? rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar: haelyon metakken, verabbi ilay mishshum rabbi chiyyay berabbi yose amar: hattachton metakken. vesiman: "veyosef hurad mitzrayma".

Lema rabbi chiyyay bar abba verabbi ilay biflugeta derabbi yose verabbanan kamippalgi? leman deamar haelyon metakken, kasavar al hammazzik leharechik et atzmo min hannizzak. uman deamar tachton metakken, kasavar al hannizzak leharechik et atzmo min hammazzik.

Vetisbera rabbi yose verabbanan leinyan nezakin peligi? veha ippecha shaminan lehu, ditnan: marchikin et hailan min habbor esrim vechamesh amma, uvecharuv uvashshikma chamishshim amma, ben millemala ben min hatztzad. im habbor kadam – kotzetz venoten damim. im hailan kadam – lo yakotz. safek ze kadam safek ze kadam – lo yakotz.

Rabbi yose omer: af al pi shehabbor kodemet lailan – lo yakotz, shezze chofer betoch shello, veze notea betoch shello. alma, rabbi yose savar al hannizzak leharechik et atzmo, verabbanan savri al hammazzik leharechik et atzmo!
Ella i ikka lememar peligi, biflugeta derabbi yose verabbanan dehatam kamippalgi.

Verabbi yose verabbanan dehacha, bemay peligi? bechozek tikra kamippalgi. rabbanan savri: maaziva achzoke tikra hu, veachzoke tikra (al ha)tachton bae (l)achzoke. verabbi yose savar: maaziva ashvoye gummot hu, veashvoye gummot (al haelyon leashvoye).
Ini? vehaamar rav ashe: ki havena be rav kahana, hava amrinan: mode rabbi yose begire dileh!
Defaski mayya vahadar nafli.

Mishna habbayit vehaaliyyay shel shenayim shennaflu, amar baal haaliyyay levaal habbayit livnot vehu eno rotze livnot – hare baal haaliyyay bone et habbayit vedar betochah, ad sheyyitten lo et yetziotav.

Rabbi yehuda omer: af ze dar betoch shel chavero, tzarich lehaalot lo sachar. ella baal haaliyyay bone et habbayit veet haaliyyay, [u]mekare et haelyona, veyoshev babbayit ad sheyyitten lo et yetziotav.
b: Gemara amar rabbi yochanan: bishlosha mekomot shana lanu rabbi yehuda asur leadam sheyyehane mimmamon chavero. chada – ha ditnan.

Iddach ma hi, ditnan: hannoten tzemer latzabba litzboa lo adom utzevao shachor, shachor utzevao adom, rabbi meir omer: noten lo deme tzamro. rabbi yehuda omer: im hashshevach yoter al hahotzaa – noten lo hayyetzia, veim hahotzaa yetera al hashshevach – noten lo et hashshevach.

Veiddach may hi, ditnan: mi sheppara miktzat chovo vehishlish et shetaro veamar lo: "im en ani noten lecha mikkan vead zeman peloni – ten lo shetaro". higgia zeman velo natan, rabbi yose omer: yitten, rabbi yehuda omer: lo yitten.
Ammay? dilma ad kan la kaamar rabbi yehuda hacha, ella mishshum deikka shachrurita.
I name litzboa lo adom utzevao shachor – mishshum deka meshanne, vehatnan: kol hameshanne yado al hattachtona.
Umi sheppara miktzat chovo name have asmachta, veshaminan leh lerabbi yehuda deamar la kane.
Amar rav acha bar adda mishshemeh deulla: tachton habba leshannot, bigvil – shomin lo, begazit – en shomin lo.
Bichfisin – shomin lo. bilvenim – en shomin lo. lesakkech baarazim – shomin lo. beshikmim – en shomin lo.
Lemaet bechallonot – shomin lo. leharebot bechallonot – en shomin lo. lehagebiah – en shomin lo. lemaet – shomin lo.
Elyon shebba leshannot, begazit – shomin lo, bigvil – en shomin lo.
Bichfisin en shomin lo, bilvenim shomin lo. baarazim en shomin lo, beshikma shomin lo. lerabbot bechallonot shomin lo, lemaet bechallonot en shomin lo. lehagebiah en shomin lo, lemaet shomin lo.
En lo laze velo laze, may? tanya: en lo lo laze velo laze – en lo levaal aliyyay bakkarka kelum.

Tanya, rabbi natan omer: tachton notel shene chalakim vehaelyon shelish. vaacherim omrim: tachton notel shelosha chalakim vehaelyon notel revia. amar rabba: nekot derabbi natan bidach, dedayyayna hu venachet leumeka dedina, ka savar: kamma mafsed aliyyay babbayit – tilta, hilkach it leh tilta.
Mishna vechen bet habbad shehu banuy bassela veginna achat al gabbav, venifchat – hare baal hagginna yored vezorea lematta ad sheyyaase levet baddo kippin.
Hakkotel vehailan shennaflu lirshut harabbim vehizziku – patur milleshallem. natnu lo zeman lakotz et hailan velistor et hakkotel, venaflu betoch hazzeman – patur, leachar hazzeman – chayyayv.
Mi shehaya kotlo samuch leginnat chavero venafal, veamar lo: panne avanecha, veamar lo:

a: Higgiucha – en shomin lo. mishshekkibbel alav amar lo: helach et yetziotecha, vaani ettol et shelli – en shomin lo.

Hassocher et happoel laasot immo batteven uvakkash, veamar lo: ten li sechari. veamar lo: tol ma sheasit bischarcha – en shomin lo. mishshekkibbel alav veamar lo: helach secharcha vaani ettol et shelli – en shomin lo.

Gemara nifchata, rav amar berubbah, ushemuel amar bearba. rav amar: berubbah, aval bearba – adam zorea chetzyo lematta vechetzyo lemala. ushemuel amar: bearba – en adam zorea chetzyo lematta vechetzyo lemala.

Utzericha: dei ashmoinan dira, beha kaamar shemuel mishshum dela avidi inashe dedayyri pureta hacha ufureta hacha, aval leinyan zeria – avidi inashe dezari hacha pureta vehacha pureta, ema mode leh lerav. vei ittemar behach, behach kaamar rav, aval beha – ema mode leh lishmuel, tzericha.
Natnu lo zeman. vechamma zeman bet din? amar rabbi yochanan: sheloshim yom.
Mi shehaya kotlo kulei. ha middekatane sefa: "helach yetziotecha", mikkelal defanninhu askinan. tama defanninhu, ha la panninhu – la.
Ammay: vetikne leh sadehu, deamar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: chatzero shel adam kona lo shello middato!
Hane mille hecha deka mikkavven leaknoye leh. aval hacha – ishtemote hu deka mishtemit leh.
Hassocher laasot immo beteven kulei. utzericha,

Dei ashmoinan lehach kammayyta, dechi kaamar leh "higgiuch" – en shomin lo, mishshum delet leh agra gabbeh. aval hacha, deit leh agra gabbeh – ema shomin lo, deamri inashe: "mimmare rashvataych pare ippera".
Vei ashmoinan hacha – hacha shemmishshekkibbel alav en shomin lo, mishshum deit leh agra gabbeh. aval hacha, delet leh agra gabbeh – ema shomin lo, tzericha.
En shomin lo. vehatanya: shomin lo! amar rav nachman: la kashya. kan beshello, kan beshel chavero.

Amar leh rava lerav nachman: beshello may tama – daamar leh: agra alach, beshel chavero name secharo alav. detanya: hassocher et happoel laasot beshello, veherahu beshel chavero – noten lo secharo mishshalem, vechozer venotel mibbaal habbayit ma shehehena oto!
Ella amar rav nachman, la kashya: kan beshello, kan beshel hefker.
Etiveh rava lerav nachman: metziat poel leatzmo, ematay? bizman sheamar lo baal habbayit nakkesh immi hayyom, o ador immi hayyom. aval im amar lo: ase immi melacha hayyom – metziato levaal habbayit!
Ella amar rav nachman, la kashya: kan – behagebaha, kan – behabbata.

Amar rabba: habbata behefker – tannae hi. ditnan: shomre sefiche sheviit notlin secharan mitterumat hallishka. rabbi yose omer: harotze mitnaddev hu veshomer chinnam. amru lo: atta omer ken? en bain mishshel tzibbur.

May lav beha kamippalgi: detanna kamma savar habbata behefker kane, vei yahayvi leh agra – in, vei la – la. verabbi yose savar habbata behefker la kane, vechi azli tzibbur umayyti – hasheta hu deka zache beh.
Uma "atta omer"? hachi kaamri leh: middevarecha lidvarenu – en omer ushete lechem bain mishshel tzibbur.

Amar rava: la, dechulle alma habbata behefker kane, vehacha chayyshinan shemma lo yimserem yafe yafe kamippalgi. derabbanan savri: yahavinan leh agra, vei la, chayyshinan shemma lo yimserem yafe yafe.

Rabbi yose savar la chayyshinan shemma lo yimserem yafe yafe, uma "atta omer"? hachi kaamri leh: middevarecha lidvarenu, dechayyshinan shemma lo yimserem yafe yafe: en omer ushete [ha]lechem bain mishshel tzibbur.

Ikka deamri, rava amar: dechulle alma habbata behefker la kane, vehacha bechayyshinan levaale zeroot kamippalgi. detanna kamma savar detakkinu rabbanan lemittav leh arba zuze, ki hechi delishmeu baale zeroot velifreshu minnayyhu. verabbi yose savar: la takkinu.
b: Uma "atta omer"? hachi kaamri leh: middevarecha lidvarenu, en [temidin umusafin] bain mishshel tzibbur. vechen ki ata ravin, amar rabbi yochanan: choshshin levaale zeroot ikka benayyhu.
Mishna hammotzi zevel lirshut harabbim, hammotzi – motzi, vehamezabbel – mezabbel. en shorin tit birshut harabbim, veen lovnim levenim. aval govlin tit birshut harabbim, aval lo levenim.
Habbone birshut harabbim, hammevi avanim – mevi, vehabbone – bone. veim hizzik – meshallem ma shehizzik. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: af metakken hu et melachto lifne sheloshim yom.

Gemara lema matnitin dela kerabbi yehuda. detanya, rabbi yehuda omer: bishat hotzaat zevalim adam motzi zivlo lirshut harabbim vetzovro kol sheloshim yom, kede sheyyehe nishshof beragle adam uveragle behema, sheal menat ken hinchil yehoshua leyisrael et haaretz.

Afillu tema rabbi yehuda, mode rabbi yehuda sheim hizzik – chayyayv leshallem. vehatnan: mode rabbi yehuda bener chanukka shehu patur, mippene shehu ose birshut. may lav: reshut devet din? la, reshut demitzva.
Vehatanya: kol ellu sheamru muttarin lekalkel birshut harabbim, im hizzik – chayyayv leshallem, verabbi yehuda poter. ella mechavvavrta matnitin dela kerabbi yehuda.

Amar abbaye: rabbi yehuda, verabban shimon ben gamliel, verabbi shimon – kullehu sevira lehu: kol makom shennatnu lo chachamim reshut vehizzik – patur. rabbi yehuda – ha daamaran. rabban shimon ben gamliel, ditnan: rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: af metakken hu et melachto lifne sheloshim yom.

Rabbi shimon, ditnan: haya maamido baaliyyay – tzarich sheyyehe tachtav maaziva shelosha tefachim, uvakkira – tefach. veim hizzik – meshallem ma shehizzik. rabbi shimon omer: lo amru kol hashshiurim hallalu ella sheim hizzik patur milleshallem.

Tanu rabbanan: hachatztzav shemmasar lassattat – hassattat chayyayv. hassattat shemmasar lachammar – hachammar chayyayv. hachammar shemmasar lakkattaf – hakkattaf chayyayv. hakkattaf shemmasar labbannay – habbannay chayyayv. habbannay shemmasar laadrichol – adrichol chayyayv. veim hinniach even al haddimos vehizzika – kullan chayyayvin leshallem.
Vehatanya: acharon chayyayv vechullan peturim! la kashya: kan bischirut, kan bekabbelanut.

Mishna shete gannot zo al gav zo, vehayyarak bentayim. rabbi meir omer: shel elyon. rabbi yehuda omer: shel tachton. amar rabbi meir: im yirtze haelyon likkach et afaro, en kan yarak. amar rabbi yehuda: im yirtze hattachton lemallovt et ginnato, en kan yarak.

Amar rabbi meir: meachar sheshshenehen yecholin lemachot ze al ze, roin mehechan yarak ze chay. amar rabbi shimon: kol shehaelyon yachol lifshot et yado velittol – hare hu shello, vehashshear shel tachton.
Gemara amar rava: beikkaro, kulle alma la peligi deelyon have. ki peligi benofo. rabbi meir savar: shedi nofo batar ikkaro. verabbi yehuda savar: la amrinan shedi nofo batar ikkaro.

Veazda letamayyhu, detanya: hayyotze min haggeza umin hashshorashin – hare ellu shel baal hakkarka, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: min haggeza – shel baal hailan, umin hashshorashin – shel baal hakkarka.

a: Utenan name gabbe arla ki hay gavvna: ilan hayyotze min haggeza umin hashsharashin – chayyayv bearla, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: min haggeza – patur, min hashsharashin – chayyayv.

Utzerichi, dei ashmoinan kammayyta: beha kaamar rabbi yehuda mishshum demamona, aval gabbe arla deissura – ema mode leh lerabbi meir. vei ittemar beha: beha kaamar rabbi meir, aval behahi – ema mode leh lerabbi yehuda, tzerichi.
Amar rabbi shimon: kol shehaelyon yachol lifshot [vechulei]. amri deve rabbi yannay: uvilvad shello yeanes.
Bae rav anan, veittema rabbi yirmeya: maggia lenofo veen maggia leikkaro, maggia leikkaro veen maggia lenofo, may? teku.
Amar efrayim safra talmido shel resh lakish mishshum resh lakish: halacha kerabbi shimon. amruha kammeh deshabbur malka, amar lehu: afrin nimteyeh lerabbi shimon.
Hadaran alach habbayit vehaaliyyay uselika la massechet bava metzia
Hashshuttafin sheratzu laasot mechitza bechatzer – bonin et hakkotel beemtza. makom shennahagu livnot gevil, gazit, kefisin, levenin – bonin; hakkol keminhag hammedina.

Gevil – ze noten shelosha tefachim, veze noten shelosha tefachim. baggazit – ze noten tifchayim umechetza veze noten tifchayim umechetza. bakkefisin – ze noten tifchayim veze noten tifchayim. bilvenin – ze noten tefach umechetza veze noten tefach umechetza. lefichach, im nafal hakkotel – hammakom vehaavanim shel shenehem.
Vechen bagginna – mekom shennahagu ligdor – mechayyeyvin oto. aval babbika – mekom shennahagu shello ligdor – en mechayyeyvin oto,
Ella im ratza, kones letoch shello uvone, veose chazit mibbachutz. lefichach, im nafal hakkotel – hammakom vehaavanim shello.
Im asu middaat shenehem – bonin et hakkotel baemtza, veosin chazit mikkan umikkan. lefichach, im nafal hakkotel – hammakom vehaavanim shel shenehem.
Gemara savruha may "mechitza" – gudda; kidtanya: mechitzat hakkerem shennifretza, omer lo: "gedor". chazra venifretza – omer lo: "gedor".
b: Nityaesh hemenna velo gedarah – hare ze kiddesh, vechayyayv beachrayutah.
Tama deratzu, ha lo ratzu – en mechayyeyvin oto; alma hezzek reiyya lav shemeh hezzek.
Veema "mechitza" – pelugeta, kedichtiv: "vattehi mechetzat haeda"; vechevan deratzu – bonin et hakkotel beal korcho, alma hezzek reiyya shemeh hezzek!

I hachi, hay "sheratzu laasot mechitza"?! "sheratzu lachatzot" mibbee leh! ella may – gudda? "bonin et hakkotel"?! "bonin oto" mibbee leh! i tena "oto", hava amena bimsifas bealma, ka mashma lan kotel.
Bonin et hakkotel baemtza vechulei. peshita!
La tzericha – dikdem chad veratztzeyyeh lechavreh; mahu detema, matze amar leh: ki itretzay lach – beavvera, betashmishta – la itretzay lach; ka mashma lan.
Vehezzek reiyya lav shemeh hezzek?! (siman: ginna, kotel, kofin, vecholkin, challonot, derav nachman).
Ta shema: "vechen beginna"!
Ginna shane, kidrabbi abba – deamar rabbi abba amar rav huna amar rav: asur laadam laamod bisde chavero beshaa shehi omedet bekamoteha.
Veha "vechen" katane! aggevil vegazit.
Ta shema: kotel chatzer shennafal – mechayyeyvin oto livnot ad arba ammot! nafal shane.
Udekaare la may kaare la? sefa itztericha leh – mearba ammot ulemala en mechayyeyvin oto.
Ta shema: kofin oto livnot bet shaar vedelet lechatzer. shema minna, hezzek reiyya shemeh hezzek! hazzika derabbim shane.
Udeyachid la? ta shema: en cholkin et hechatzer, ad sheyyehe bah arba ammot laze vearba ammot laze. ha yesh bah kede laze uchede laze – cholkin; may, lav bechotel? la, bimsifas bealma.

Ta shema: hachallonot, ben millemala ben millematta uven mikkenegdan – arba ammot. vetane ala: millemalan – kede shello yatzitz veyire; millemattan – kede shello yaamod veyire; mikkenegdan – kede shello yaafil!
Hezzeka devayit shane.

Ta shema, deamar rav nachman amar shemuel: gag hassamuch lachatzar chavero – osin lo maake gavoah arba ammot! shane hatam, deamar leh baal hechatzer levaal haggag: ledidi kevia li tashmishi, ledidach la kevia lach tashmishtach; vela yadana behe iddana selika veatet –

a: Deitztanna minnach.
Lishshana acharina amri la: savruha, may "mechitza" – pelugeta, dichtiv: "vattehi mechetzat haeda"; vechevan deratzu – bonin et hakkotel beal korchan, alma hezzek reiyya shemeh hezzek.
Ema: may "mechitza" – gudda; ditnan: mechitzat hakkerem shennifretza – omer lo: "gedor". nifretza – omer lo: "gedor". nityaesh hemenna velo gedarah – hare ze kiddesh, vechayyayv beachrayutah.
Vetama deratzu, ha lo ratzu – en mechayyeyvin oto, alma hezzek reiyya lav shemeh hezzek!
I hachi, "bonin et hakkotel"?! "bonin oto" mibbee leh! ella may – pelugeta? i hachi, "sheratzu laasot mechitza"?! "sheratzu lachatzot" mibbee leh! kidamri inashe: ta naaved pelugeta.
Vei hezzek reiyya shemeh hezzek – may irya ratzu? afillu lo ratzu name! amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan: mishnatenu – kesheen bah din chalukah, vehu deratzu.

May ka mashma lan – dechi let beh din chalukah, ki ratzu – peligi?! tenena: ematay – bizman sheen shenehem rotzim, aval bizman sheshshenehem rotzim – afillu pachot mikkan cholkin! i mehatam, hava amena afillu pachot mikkan – bimsifas bealma; ka mashma lan hacha, kotel.
Velitne ha vela litne hach! sefa itztericha leh – vechitve hakkodesh, af al pi sheshshenehem rotzim – lo yachloku.
(Lishshana acharina: vechi ratzu may have? lihdar beh! amar rav assi amar rabbi yochanan: beshekkanu miyyado kulei.

Addeashmeinan besheen bah din chalukah – vehu deratzu, layshmeinan beyesh bah din chalukah – veaf al gav delo ratzu! i ashmeinan beyesh bah din chalukah – veaf al gav delo ratzu, hava amena: sheen bah din chalukah – afillu ratzu name la; ka mashma lan.
Umi matzet amrat hachi?! veha katane sefa: ematay – bizman sheen shenehem rotzim, aval bizman sheshshenehem rotzim – yachloku. may, lav akkotel? la, ammesifas bealma.
Litne hay vela litne hay! sefa itztericha leh – uvechitve hakkodesh, af al pi sheshshenehem rotzim – lo yachloku).
Bemay okemta lematnitin – besheen bah din chalukah; i besheen bah din chalukah, ki ratzu may have? nehderu behu! amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan: shekkanu miyyadan.
Vechi kanu miyyadan may have? kinyan devarim bealma hu! beshekkanu miyyadan beruchot. rav ashe amar: kegon shehalach ze betoch shello vehechezik, veze betoch shello vehechezik.
Makom shennahagu livnot kulei. gevil – avne dela meshappeya. gazit – avne dimshappeya, dichtiv: "kol elle avanim yekarot kemiddot gazit (vegomer)" kefisin – arche. levenin – livne.
Amar leh rabba bereh derava lerav ashe: mimmay digvil avne dela meshappeya ninhu, vehay tefach yattira – lemuresha dekarnata? dilma palga degazit hu, vehay tefach yattira – levene ureve hu;
Kidkaamrinan: kefisin – arche, levenin – livne, vehay tefach yattira – levene ureve!
Amar leh: velitamaych, kefisin – arche, menalan? ella gemara gemiri la, gevil name – avne dela meshappeya, gemara gemiri la.

Ikka deamri, amar leh rav acha bereh derav avya lerav ashe: mimmay dehay kefisin – arche ninhu, vehay tefach yattira – levene ureve? dilma may kefisin – avne dela meshappeyayn, vehay tefach yattira – lemuresha dekarnata; kidkaamrinan: gevil – avne dela meshappeyayn, gazit – avne dimshappeyayn, vehay tefach yattira – lemuresha dekarnata!
Amar leh: velitamaych, gevil – avne dela meshappeyayn, menalan? ella gemara gemiri la, hacha name – gemara gemiri la.
Amar abbaye, shema minna: kol bene ureve – tefach; hane mille betina, aval berichsa bae tefe. veikka deamri: hane mille berichsa, aval betina la bae kulle hay.

Lememra divgazit; dechol arba ammot gova, i have puteya chamsha – kae, i la – la kae?! veha amma teraksin; dahavay gavoah telatin ammehata, vela hava puteya ella shet pusheche; vekam! kevan deikka tefach yattira – kae.
Uvemikdash sheni may tama la avud amma teraksin? ki kae – bitlatin kae, tefe la kae.
Umenalan dahava gavoah tefe? dichtiv: "gadol yihye kevod habbayit hazze haacharon min harishon" – rav ushemuel; veamri la rabbi yochanan verabbi elazar; chad amar: bevinyan, vechad amar:
b: Beshanim. veita leha veita leha.
Venebedu telatin ammin bevinyan, veiddach nebed parochet! ki kae telatin ammehata name – aggav tikra umaaziva hava kae, belo tikra umaaziva – la hava kae.
Velebed ma deefshar bevinyan, velebed iddach parochet! amar abbaye, gemiri: i kullehu bevinyan, i kullehu befarochet. i kullehu bevinyan – mimmikdash, i kullehu befarochet – mimmishkan.

Ibbaya lehu: hen vesidan, o dilma hen belo sidan? amar rav nachman bar yitzchak, mistabbera: hen vesidan; dei salka datach hen belo sidan, litneyeh leshiureh! ella lav shema minna: hen vesidan? la; leolam ema lach: hen belo sidan; vechevan dela have tefach, la tane.
Veha katane: bilvenin – ze noten tefach umechetza veze noten tefach umechetza! hatam chazi leitzterofe.
Ta shema: hakkora sheamru – rechava kede lekabbel ariach, vehaariach – chatzi levena shel shelosha tefachim!
Hatam beravrevata. dayka name, dekatane: "shel shelosha tefachim", michlal deikka zutera; shema minna.
Amar rav chisda: lo listor inish be chenishta, ad devane be chenishta achariti. ikka deamri: mishshum peshiuta, veikka deamri: mishshum tzalloye.
May benayyhu? ikka benayyhu deikka be chenishta achariti. marimar umar zutera satri uvanu be kayyta besitvo, uvanu be sitvo bekayyta.
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe: gevu zuze umachati, may? amar leh: dilma mitreme lehu pidyon shevuyim, veyahavi lehu.
