Sherigi livne, vehadri hudere, umachati keshure, may? amar leh: zimnin demitreme lehu pidyon shevuyim, mezabbeni veyahavi lehu. i hachi, afillu banu name! amar leh: dirteh deinashe la mezabbeni.

Vela amaran ella dela chaze bah tivha, aval chaze bah tivha – satri uvane. ki ha derav ashe chaza bah tivha bichnishta demata machseya, satreh veayyel lefureyeh lehatam, vela appekeh ad dimtakken leh shefiche.

Uvava ben buta, hechi asseveh leh etza lehordos lemistereh levet hammikdash? vehaamar rav chisda: la listor inish be chenishta ad devane be chenishta achrita! i baet ema: tivha chaza beh, ibbaet ema: malchuta shane, dela hadra beh; deamar shemuel, i amar malchuta: "akarna ture" – akar ture vela hadar beh.

Hordos avda devet chashmonay hava. natan enav beotah tinoket. yoma chad, shema hahu gavra bat kala deamar: kol avda demared hasheta, matzlach. kam katlinhu lechullehu marvateh, veshayyeyra lehahi yanokta. ki chazat hahi yanokta deka bae leminseva, selika leiggara, urema kala amara: "kol man deate veamar: mibbet chashmonay kaatena – avda hu, dela ishteyayra minnayyhu ella hahi yanokta, vehahi yanokta nefala meiggara leara".

Tamna sheva shenin beduvesha. ikka deamri: ba aleha, ikka deamri: la ba aleha. deamri la ba aleha, ha detamna – leyattoveh leyitzreh. udeamri la lo ba aleha, hay detamna – ki hechi denemru: bat melech nesav.
Amar: man daresh "mikkerev achecha tasim alecha melech"? rabbanan. kam katlinhu lechullehu rabbanan, shavkeh levava ben buta lemishkal etza minneh.

a: Ahdar leh kelila deyayle, nakkerinhu leeneh. yoma chad ata vitiv kammeh, amar: chazi mar, hay avda bisha may ka aved! amar leh: may eeved leh? amar leh: nilteyeh mar! amar leh: ketiv "gam bemaddaacha, melech al tekallel". amar leh: hay lav melech hu! amar leh: velihve ashir bealma, uchetiv: "uvechadre mishkavcha al tekallel ashir"; velo yehe ella nasi, uchetiv: "venasi veammecha lo taor".

Amar leh: beose maase ammecha, vehay lav ose maase ammecha! amar leh: mistefena minneh. amar leh: lekka inish deazel delema leh, daana veat yatevna. amar leh, ketiv: "ki of hashshamayim yolich et hakkol uvaal kenafayim yagged davar".

Amar leh: ana hu, i havay yadana dizhiri rabbanan kulle hay, la hava katelna lehu; hasheta may takkanteh dehahu gavra? amar leh: hu kibba oro shel olam, dichtiv: "ki ner mitzva vetora or", yelech veyaasok beoro shel olam, dichtiv: "venaharu elav kol haggoyim". ikka deamri, hachi amar leh: hu simme eno shel olam, dichtiv: "vehaya im meene haeda", yelech veyitassek beeno shel olam, dichtiv: "hinni mechallel et mikdashi, geon uzzechem machmad enechem".

Amar leh: mistefena mimmalchuta. amar leh: shaddar shelicha; velezil shatta, veliakkav shatta, velehdar shatta; addehachi vehachi satrayt [leh] uvanyayt [leh]. avad hachi. shelachu leh: im lo satarta – al tistor; veim satarta – al tivne; veim satarta uvanita – avde bisha, batar deavdin mitmalchin. im zayynach alach, sifrach kan – la recha vela bar recha, hordos [avda] kalanya mitavid.
May "recha"? malchuta – dichtiv: "anochi hayyom rach umashuach melech". vei baet ema, mehacha: "vayyikreu lefanav avrech".

Amri: mi shello raa binyan hordos, lo raa binyan nae [miyyamav]. bemay banyeh? amar rabba: beavne shisha umarmera. ikka deamri: beavne kuchela, shisha umarmera. appek safa veayyel safa, ki hechi dinkabbel sida. sevar lemishayeh bedahava, amaru leh rabbanan: shivkeh, dehachi shappir tefe, demichze ki idvota deyamma.

Uvava bar buta hechi avad hachi? vehaamar rav yehuda amar rav, veittema rabbi yehoshua ben levi: mippene ma neenash daniyyel? mippene shehissi etza linvuchadnetztzar, shenneemar: "lahen malka, milki yishpar alach, vachataaych betzidka feruk, vaavayatach bemichan anayin, hen teheve archa lishlevtach vegomer", uchetiv: "kolla meta al nevuchadnetztzar malka", uchetiv: "veliktzat yarchin tere asar vegomer"!
Ibbaet ema: shane avda, deichayyayv bemitzvot. veibbaet ema: shane bet hammikdash, dei la malchut – la mitbene.

Vedaniyyel – menalan deianash? illema mishshum dichtiv: "vattikra ester lahatach", veamar rav: hatach – ze daniel; hanicha leman deamar: "shechatachuhu miggedullato", ella leman deamar: "shekkol divre malchut nechtachin al piv", may ikka lememar? deshadyuhu legubba dearyavota.
Hakkol keminhag hammedina. "hakkol" – leetoye may? leetoye atra dinhigi behutza vedafna.

Lefichach, im nafal hakkotel – hammakom vehaavanim shel shenehem. peshita! la tzericha, dinfal lirshuta dechad minnayyhu, i name defanninhu chad lirshuta dideh; mahu detema: nihve iddach "hammotzi mechavero alav haraya", ka mashma lan.
Vechen beginna, mekom shennahagu ligdor – mechayyeyvin oto. ha gufa kashya – amrat: vechen beginna, mekom shennahagu ligdor – mechayyeyvin oto; ha setama – en mechayyeyvin oto;
Ema sefa: aval bika, mekom shennahagu shello ligdor – en mechayyeyvin oto; ha setama – mechayyeyvin oto. hasheta setam ginna – amrat la, setam bika mibbaya?!

Amar abbaye, hachi kaamar: vechen setam ginna, uvimkom shennahagu ligdor bevika – mechayyeyvin oto. amar leh rava: im ken, may "aval"? ella amar rava, hachi katane: vechen setam ginna – kimkom shennahagu ligdor dame, umechayyeyvin oto. aval setam bika – kimkom shello nahagu dame, veen mechayyeyvin oto.

Ella im ratza, kones letoch shello uvone, veose chazit. may "chazit"? amar rav huna: achpeye leh lekarna levar. venaaved millegav! aved chavreh name millevar, veamar: didi vedideh hu. i hachi, hasheta name – gayez leh chavreh, vaamar: didi vedideh hu! gizzuza midda yedia.

Ikka deamri, amar rav huna: michpa lekarna millegav. venebad millevar! gayez leh chavreh, veamar: didi vedideh hu. i hachi, hasheta name layef leh chavreh, veamar: didi vedideh hu! lippufa midda yedia. veha "mibbachutz" katane! kashya.
Rabbi yochanan amar:
b: Nishayeh beammeta millevar. veneevad millegav! aved chavreh millevar, veamar: didi vedideh hu. i hachi, hasheta name – dekafel leh chavreh, veamar: didi vedideh hu! killufa midda yedia.

Hutza – amar rav nachman: saynnofe yereche millevar. venebad millegav! aved name chavreh millevar, veamar: didi vedideh hu. i hachi, hasheta name – gayez veshade leh, veamar: didi vedideh hu! mashrek leh tina. hasheta name – ate chavreh vekalef leh! killufa midda yedia.
Abbaye amar: hutza let leh takkanta ella bishtara.
Aval im asu middaat shenehem. amar leh rava mipparzika lerav ashe: la yaasu lo ze velo ze! amar leh: la tzericha, dikdem chad minnayyhu vaavad dideh, vei la aved chavreh – amar: dideh hu.
Vetanna – takkanta lerammay ka mashma lan?! amar leh: veresha – lav takkanta lerammay hu?!

Amar leh: bishlama resha – tena dina, umishshum dina tena takkanta; ella sefa, dina katane – dekatane takkanta?! amar ravina: hacha behutze askinan, leappoke middeabbayye – deamar: hutza let leh takkanta ella bishtara; ka mashma lan devachazit saggi.

Mishna hammakkif et chavero mishshalosh ruchotav, vegadar et harishona veet hashsheniyya veet hashshelishit – en mechayyeyvin oto. rabbi yose omer: im amad vegadar et harviit – megalgelin alav et hakkol.
Gemara amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: halacha kerabbi yose, deamar: im amad vegadar et harviit – megalgelin alav et hakkol. la shena amad nikkaf, la shena amad makkif.
Ittemar, rav huna amar: hakkol lefi ma sheggadar. chiyyay bar rav amar: hakkol lefi deme kanim bezol.

Tenan: hammakkif et chavero mishshalosh ruchotav, vegadar et harishona veet hashsheniyya veet hashshelishit – en mechayyeyvin oto. ha reviit – mechayyeyvin oto; ema sefa, rabbi yose omer: im amad vegadar et harviit – megalgelin alav et hakkol.

Bishlama lerav huna, deamar: hakkol lefi ma sheggadar bah, hayeynu deikka ben tanna kamma verabbi yose – tanna kamma savar: hakkol lefi deme kanim bezol – in, uma sheggadar – la; verabbi yose savar: hakkol lefi ma sheggadar.
Ella lechiyyay bar rav, deamar: hakkol lefi deme kanim bezol, may ikka ben tanna kamma lerabbi yose? i deme kanim bezol la kayahev leh, may kayahev leh?
I baet ema: agar netira ikka benayyhu – tanna kamma savar: agar netira – in, deme kanim bezol – la; verabbi yose savar: deme kanim bezol.

Vei baet ema: rishona sheniyya ushelishit ikka benayyhu – tanna kamma savar: reviit hu deyahev leh, aval rishona sheniyya ushelishit – la yahev leh; verabbi yose savar: rishona sheniyyay ushelishit name yahev leh.
Ibbaet ema: makkif venikkaf ikka benayyhu – detanna kamma sover: tama deamad nikkaf dimgalgelin alav et hakkol, aval amad makkif – eno noten lo ella deme reviit.
Verabbi yose savar: la shena nikkaf vela shena makkif, im amad vegadar – megalgelin alav et hakkol.

Lishshana acharina: makkif venikkaf ikka benayyhu – tanna kamma savar: im gadar makkif et harviit – name yahev leh; verabbi yose savar: im amad nikkaf vegadar et harviit – hu deyahev leh, degalli dateh denicha leh; aval im gadar makkif – la yahev leh midde.

a: Runeya, akkefeh ravina mearba ruchotav. amar leh: "hav li kamma digdari", la yehev leh. "hav li lefi kanim bezol", la yehev leh. "hav li agar netiruta", la yehev leh.

Yoma chad hava ka gader dikle, amar leh laariseh: zil shekol minneh kibbura daahine. azal leetoye, rema beh kala. amar leh: gallit datach deminnach nicha lach; la yehe ella izza bealma, mi la bae netiruta? amar leh: izza bealma, lav leachloye baaya? amar leh: vela gavra baet demaychle la?
Ata lekammeh derava, amar leh: zil payyeyseh bemay deippayyays; vei la, daenna lach dina kerav huna allibba derabbi yose.
Runeya zeven ara ammitzra deravina. sevar ravina lesalloke mishshum dina devar mitzra; amar leh rav safra bereh derav yeva leravina, amri inashe: arbea letzalla, arbea letzallala.
Mishna kotel chatzer shennafal – mechayyeyvin oto livnoto ad arba ammot. bechezkat shennatan, ad sheyyavi reaya shello natan.
Mearba ammot ulemalan – en mechayyeyvin oto. samach lo kotel acher, af al pi shello natan alav et hattikra – megalgelin alav et hakkol. bechezkat shello natan, ad sheyyavi reaya shennatan.

Gemara amar resh lakish: hakkovea zeman lachavero, veamar lo: "peraticha betoch zemanni" – eno neeman; ulevay sheyyifra bizmanno. abbaye verava deamri tarvayyhu: avid inish defara bego zimneh – zimnin demitremu leh zuze, amar: ezil efreeh,
b: Ki hechi dela litredan.
Tenan: – bechezkat shennatan, ad sheyyavi reaya shello natan.

Hechi dame? ilema daamar leh: "peraticha bizmanni", peshita bechezkat shennatan! ella lav daamar leh: "peratich betoch zemanni"? alma avid inish defareh betoch zimneh! shane hacha, dechol safa vesafa zimneh hu.
Ta shema: bechezkat shello natan, ad sheyyavi reaya shennatan.

Hechi dame? ilema daamar leh: "peraticha bizmanni", ammay la? ella lav daamar leh: "peratich betoch zemanni"? alma la avid inish defara bego zimneh! shane hacha, deamar: mi yemar dimchayyeyvu li rabbanan.

Rav pappa verav huna bereh derav yehoshua avdi keabbayye verava. mar bar rav ashe aved keresh lakish. vehilcheta keresh lakish, vaafillu miyyatme; veaf al gav deamar mar: habba lippara minnichse yetomim – lo yippara ella bishvua; chazaka: la avid inish defara bego zimneh.
Ibbaya lehu: tevao leachar zeman, veamar lo: "peraticha betoch zemanni", mahu? mi amrinan: bimkom chazaka – amrinan "ma li leshakker";

a: O dilma, bimkom chazaka – la amrinan "ma li leshakker"? ta shema: bechezkat shennatan, ad sheyyavi reaya shello natan.

Hechi dame? illema shettevao leachar zeman, veamar lo: "peraticha bizmanni", peshita! ella lav daamar leh: "peraticha betoch zemanni"? alma afillu bimkom chazaka, amrinan "ma li leshakker"! shane hacha, dechol safa vesafa zimneh hu.
Ta shema: mearba ammot ulemala – en mechayyeyvin oto. samach lo kotel acher kulei, ad sheyyavi reaya shennatan.

Hechi dame? illema shettevao leachar zemanno, veamar lo: "peraticha bizmanni", ammay la? ella lav deamar: "peraticha betoch zemanni"? alma bimkom chazaka la amrinan "ma li leshakker"! shane hacha, deamar: mi yemar dimchayyeyvi li rabbanan?
Amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe, ta shema: "mane li beyadcha", amar lo: "hin". lemachar amar lo: "tenehu li"; im amar: "netattiv lach" – patur. "en lecha beyadi" – chayyayv.

May, lav "netattiv lach" – daamar leh: "peraticha bizmanni"; "en lecha beyadi" – daamar leh: "peraticha betoch zemanni"? vekatane: chayyayv; alma bimkom chazaka – la amrinan "ma li leshakker"! la; may "en lecha beyadi" – "lo hayu devarim meolam", deamar mar: kol haomer "lo laviti" – keomer "lo parati" dame.
Samach lo kotel acher – megalgelin alav et hakkol kulei. amar rav huna: semach lefalga, semach lechulla. verav nachman amar: lemay dismach – semach, lemay dela semach – la semach.
Umode rav huna bekarna velufeta. umode rav nachman beafriza, uvikvata dichshure.
Amar rav huna: be chavve – la have chazaka, veaf al gav daavad leh himlate. deamar leh, amena: lechi payysat li, la littera ashitay.
Amar rav nachman: achzek lehurede – la achzek lichshure, lichshure – achzek lehurede. rav yosef amar: achzek lehurede – achzek lichshure.
Ikka deamri, amar rav nachman: achzek lehurede – achzek lichshure, lichshure – achzek lehurede.
Amar rav nachman: achzek lenitfe – achzek leshafche, achzek leshafche – la achzek lenitfe. verav yosef amar: afillu achzek leshafche – achzek lenitfe.

Ikka deamri, amar rav nachman: achzek leshafche – achzek lenitfe; lenitfe – achzek leshafche, aval litzrifa deurebane – la. rav yosef amar: afillu tzerifa deurebane. avad rav yosef ovada bitzrifa deurebane.
Amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: hammaskir bayit lachavero
b: Bevira gedola, mishtammesh bezizeha uvichtaleha ad arba ammot, uveovi hakkotel – bimkom shennahagu, aval betarbetz appadne – la. verav nachman dideh amar: afillu betarbetz appadne, aval rechava sheachore habbattim – la. verava amar: afillu rechava sheachore habbattim.

Amar ravina: hay keshura dimtallalta, ad telatin yomin – la have chazaka, batar telatin yomin – have chazaka. vei sukka demitzva hi, ad shiva yomin – la have chazaka, batar shiva yomin – have chazaka. vei chabbereh betina – lealtar have chazaka.
Amar abbaye: shene vattim bishne tzidde reshut harabbim – ze ose maake lachatzi gaggo, veze ose maake lachatzi gaggo – ze shello keneged ze; umaadif.
May irya birshut harabbim? afillu reshut hayyachid name! reshut harabbim itztericha leh – mahu detema, nema leh: sof sof ha baet leitztannoe mibbene reshut harabbim;

Ka mashma lan, deamar leh: rabbim – bimama chazu li, belelya la chazu li; at – ben bimama ben belelya chazet li. i name, rabbim – ki kaemna chazu li, ki yatevna la chazu li; at chazet li ben ki kaemna ben ki yatevna. rabbim – ki meayyeynu chazu li, ki la meayyeynu la chazu li; at – mimmela name chazet li.
Amar mar: ze ose maake lachatzi gaggo, veze ose maake lachatzi gaggo – ze shello keneged ze; umaadif. peshita!

La tzericha, dikdem chad minnayyhu vaavad. mahu detema, nema leh iddach: shekol uzinka veivdeh at kulleh; ka mashma lan, deamar leh: at may tama la avadt – mishshum demittera ashitach; ana name mittera leh ashitay.

Amar rav nachman amar shemuel: gag hassamuch lachatzar chavero – ose lo maake gavoah arba ammot. aval ben gag legag – la. verav nachman dideh amar: eno zakuk learba ammot, aval zakuk limchitzat asara.

Lemay? i lehezzek reiyya – arba ammot baenan! i lenitpas alav kegannav – bimsifas bealma saggi! i ligdayim utelaim – bichde shello yizdakker bevat rosh saggi! leolam lenitpas alav kegannav, bimsifas – matze mishtemit leh, [amar: mamtzore kamamtzerna], bimchitzat asara – la matze mishtemit leh.
Metivi: im haya chatzero lemala miggaggo shel chavero – en nizkakin lo. may, lav en nizkakin lo kelal? la; en nizkakin learba ammot, aval nizkakin limchitzat asara.
Ittemar: shete chatzerot zo lemala mizzo – amar rav huna: tachton bone mikkenegdo veole, veelyon bone mikkenegdo veole. verav chisda amar: elyon mesayyea millematta uvone.

Tanya kevoteh derav chisda: shete chatzerot zo lemala mizzo, lo yomar haelyon: "hareni bone mikkenegdi veole", ella mesayyea millematta uvone. veim hayta chatzero lemala miggaggo shel chavero – eno zakuk lo.
Hanhu be tere dahavo dayyri, chad hava dayer illay vechad hava dayer tattay. ittevar tattay. amar leh tattay leillay: "ta venivneyeh". amar leh: "ana shappir ka daerna".
